content:
## 美国三年来首次加息 对全球和中国意味着什么？

视频加注文字，美联储为何提高利率？（英文）

*       *   Author, 麦可·雷斯（Michael Race）
    *   Role, BBC商业记者
    *   Reporting from, 华盛顿报导

*   Published 5 小时前

*   阅读时间: 3 分钟

美国利率三年多来首次上调，为了遏止物价上涨，利率可能还会进一步提高。

美国联邦储备局（Federal Reserve）以一致投票决定，将利率从 3.5% 至 3.75% 上调至 3.75% 至 4%。此前，总统唐纳德·特朗普（Donald Trump；川普）一直呼吁降息，并对加息表示强烈反对。

美联储主席凯文·沃什（Kevin Warsh）表示，此举是因为“通胀过高，且持续时间过长”，并称这是一个“清醒”且“负责任的决定”。

在宣布加息后，特朗普表达了对沃什的支持，但称负责投票就利率决策的美联储理事会“充满敌意”。

沃什在周三（9月16日）议息决定公布后的新闻发布会上表示，尽管美联储领导层内部存在“乐观情绪”，但通胀依然是一个问题。

与许多央行一样，美联储设定了将通胀率控制在2%或以下的目标。沃什指出，美国通胀率已经“五年多”高于目标水平。

这使得生活负担成为美国选民最关切的问题之一——自美国与以色列对伊朗开战以来，批发油价飙升，带动燃料价格大涨，也推高了许多商品和服务的成本。

沃什表示，尽管美联储“无法影响任何单一价格——无论是油价，还是杂货店的食品价格”，但央行可以致力于防止物价上涨蔓延至整个经济。

他还表示，就业市场和整体经济的强劲表现，意味着美联储将继续专注于稳定物价，而收入最低的群体将从低通胀中获益最多。

央行通常在通胀高企时加息，以抑制消费、鼓励储蓄，从而希望减缓物价上涨速度。但这是一场平衡之术，因为更高的利率也可能促使企业推迟投资，损害经济增长。

视频加注文字，美联储主席称加息决定“负责任”。（英语影片）

## 更高的利率对美国人意味着什么

沃什获得任命时，民主党议员曾称他将成为特朗普的“傀儡”，许多美联储观察人士也预计他会执行特朗普持续要求大幅降息的主张。特朗普此前曾严厉批评沃什的前任杰罗姆·鲍威尔（Jerome Powell）不愿降息。

周三被问及这次加息向特朗普传递了什么讯息时，沃什笑了笑，然后说：“关于与总统的讨论，我没有什么可告诉你的。”

特朗普其后告诉记者：“我很倚重凯文（沃什），但他面对的，你知道，是一个很不好对付的理事会。”

他还说：“利率太高了，并不合适⋯⋯我跟凯文谈过，我说，‘你不妨跟理事会一起投票，反正也无所谓’。理事会充满敌意，他们非常政治化。”

稍早时，特朗普在社交媒体上写道：“为美利坚合众国降低利率，而且要快！”

国会山庄的民主党人表示，加息将使贷款成本更高，进而导致更多美国人陷入债务。

参议院民主党领袖查克·舒默（Chuck Schumer）说：“这会让所有东西都变得更贵。这是因为唐纳德·特朗普不懂得如何管理经济。”

这次加息是美联储自2025年12月降息以来首次调整利率。上次加息是在2023年7月。

此次加息可能推高购房者的按揭利率，并导致美国人在其他类型债务上的支出增加。

摩根大通（JP Morgan）、KeyCorp和纽约梅隆银行（BNY）等美国主要银行周三均将最优惠贷款利率从6.75%上调至7%，这将影响信用卡和个人贷款的利率。

过去一年，按揭成本有所攀升，但仍低于2023年的峰值。根据房贷美（Freddie Mac）的数据，30年期固定利率按揭的平均利率为6.76%，15年期则为6.09%。

许多美国房主持有30年期或15年期固定利率按揭，利率变动不会影响他们的月供。但更高的利率可能影响希望申请新按揭或再融资的人士。

沃什拒绝就他个人对美联储利率走势的看法表态，但其大多数同僚表示，预计年底前利率将再次上调至 4% 至 4.25% 之间。

略占多数的官员还表示，明年利率可能进一步升至 4.25% 至 4.5% 区间，之后在2028年和2029年才会开始降息。

相关预测显示，物价涨幅将在未来数年趋缓，作为衡量生活成本的指标，通胀率预计将逐步回落，到2029年降至美联储的目标水平。

自伊朗战争以来，面对通胀上升的不止美联储——欧洲央行（European Central Bank）上周已加息，英格兰银行（Bank of England；英伦银行）也将于周四（17日）作出自己的利率决定。

## 中美利率“冰火两重天”

**BBC中文记者陈岩**

图像来源，Reuters

加息的“息”，指的是美国联邦基金利率，简单来说，这是美国银行之间互相借钱时使用的利率。

加息就是把这个利率调高。银行的借贷成本上升，给企业和个人放贷的利率也会跟着涨，大家借钱的意愿自然下降，贷款需求减少，市面上流通的货币供给量随之收紧，通胀压力得到缓解，经济也就慢慢降温。

反过来，如果降息，银行放贷的利率会降低，借钱的成本更便宜，企业和个人都更愿意贷款，更多资金流入实体经济，整体经济活动也会变得更活跃。

美联储调节这个利率，归根结底是为了实现一个目标：让美国的就业最大化，同时保持物价稳定。经济疲软的时候降息，向市场注入更多流动性，刺激经济复苏；经济过热的时候加息，收紧货币供应，抑制通胀，避免经济过快膨胀带来的风险。

放到当下来看，中国和美国的经济状况可谓冰火两重天——这并不是说谁的经济更好、谁更差，而是两国正面临着截然相反的问题。

自从与伊朗的冲突升级以来，油价持续攀升，美国陷入了一种“输入型通胀”的局面：能源价格上涨，带动整体物价水平一起走高。这迫使美联储现在不得不加息，收紧市面上流通的资金，给经济降温，让物价慢慢回落。

中国的情况几乎是镜像的反面。今年8月的物价指数同比只上涨了0.8%，7月更低，只有0.5%。消费始终不旺，房地产市场也持续低迷，经济面临的是需求不足、物价涨不动的压力。因此，中国央行的政策倾向是进一步降息，降低个人和企业的借钱成本，借此刺激大家去投资、去消费。

不过，这种降息的想法目前更多还停留在“想做”的阶段，尚未大幅落地。原因在于，中美之间的利率差距已经拉得很大。如果这时候中国大幅降息，而美国又同步加息，两边的利差会进一步拉开，资金可能更倾向于流向收益更高的美元资产，人民币贬值和资金外流的风险也会随之上升。所以，中国央行在降息上颇为谨慎。

正因为如此，中国政府往往更依赖发放消费补贴、对房地产给予定向支持，来刺激内需，而不是以来调节基准利率；美国则更习惯用利率这一个总量工具来调节整个经济。这也从侧面反映出，两国政府在经济治理思路上的不同选择。

title: US, China security experts propose nuclear-style safeguards for AI risks
summary: * Summary * US, Chinese experts propose red lines around nuclear systems * Calls include human-only military decisions and AI incident hotline * Recommendations come ahead of planned US-China AI talks * AI rivalry expands from chips and mod
content:
*   Summary

*   US, Chinese experts propose red lines around nuclear systems
*   Calls include human-only military decisions and AI incident hotline
*   Recommendations come ahead of planned US-China AI talks
*   AI rivalry expands from chips and models to strategic stability

BEIJING, Sept 17 (Reuters) - An AI system that interferes with a nuclear command network or launches a military cyber operation could leave Washington or Beijing with minutes to decide whether the ​other government attacked, according to U.S. and Chinese security experts.

The experts, part of a U.S.-China dialogue whose work helps inform official discussions, are urging both governments to prepare ‌for such scenarios amid [rising concerns](https://www.reuters.com/business/retail-consumer/hallucinating-ai-chatbots-wiping-out-humanity-how-did-we-get-here-2026-09-15/) about increasingly powerful and more autonomous systems.

Make sense of global markets with the Trading Day newsletter. Sign up [here.](https://www.reuters.com/newsletters/trading-day/?location=article-paragraph&redirectUrl=%2Fworld%2Fchina%2Fus-china-security-experts-propose-nuclear-style-safeguards-ai-risks-2026-09-17%2F)

Report Ad![Image 1](blob:http://localhost/a2f9abce2c7bd7e72f7c1065e8e25533)

Their proposals include red lines around nuclear systems, human control over consequential cyberattacks and a hotline for incidents involving autonomous AI.

The recommendations were

[published last week, opens new tab](https://www.brookings.edu/articles/advancing-human-control-of-military-ai/)
ahead of planned [government-level AI talks](https://www.reuters.com/legal/litigation/ai-rivalry-hangs-over-trump-xi-talks-2026-09-16/) and an expected September 24 meeting in Washington between U.S. President [Donald Trump](https://www.reuters.com/world/us/donald-trump/) and Chinese President Xi Jinping.

Authors Melanie Sisson, a senior fellow at the Brookings Institution think tank, and Tianjiao Jiang, an associate professor at Fudan University, participated ​in the U.S.-China AI and national security dialogue convened since 2019 by Brookings and Tsinghua University's Center for International Security and Strategy.

Their proposals show how the U.S.-China AI rivalry is moving ​beyond competition over chips and advanced models into questions long associated with arms control: how to prevent accidents from being mistaken for attacks, limit machine-made ⁠military decisions and set communication protocols for nuclear-armed rivals when technology behaves unexpectedly.

China's State Security Minister [Chen Yixin](https://www.reuters.com/legal/litigation/how-china-is-preparing-risk-ai-escaping-human-control-2026-09-14/) this week wrote in a government outlet that AI "fundamentally transforms the form of military struggle". He said ​it had moved from playing a supporting role on the battlefield to a key role, citing AI-directed strikes in the U.S.-Israeli war with [Iran](https://www.reuters.com/world/iran/).

## RED LINES AROUND NUCLEAR SYSTEMS

Brookings Institution's Sisson argued that humans should retain sole ​authority to initiate AI-enabled cyberattacks against the other country's nuclear command, control and communications systems or strategically important infrastructure.

An autonomous system could malfunction, exceed its instructions or be compromised, while the country under attack might struggle to tell whether the action was accidental or ordered by its rival.

Fudan University's Jiang proposed explicit red lines preventing AI from independently deciding to use nuclear weapons or autonomously attacking nuclear command systems, along with protections around critical infrastructure including energy, finance and ​healthcare.

He also urged a shared definition of "meaningful human control" to prevent both countries from using identical language to justify different levels of machine autonomy.

The idea builds on a principle endorsed by then-U.S. President ​Joe Biden and Xi in November 2024 that [humans should retain control](https://www.reuters.com/world/biden-xi-agreed-that-humans-not-ai-should-control-nuclear-weapons-white-house-2024-11-16/) over decisions to use nuclear weapons.

U.S. and Chinese flags are seen in this illustration created on April 10, 2025. REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration/File Photo [Purchase Licensing Rights, opens new tab](https://www.reutersconnect.com/item/illustration-shows-us-and-chinese-flags/dGFnOnJldXRlcnMuY29tLDIwMjY6bmV3c21sX1JDMjBBTkFCQkFESg%3D%3D/?utm_medium=rcom-article-media&utm_campaign=rcom-rcp-lead)

Lora Saalman, an associate senior fellow at the Stockholm International Peace Research Institute, wrote in February that this was an important point ‌of U.S.-China ⁠convergence even as both countries showed signs of integrating AI more deeply into nuclear and nuclear-related systems.

## WHEN MACHINES MOVE FASTER THAN HUMANS

Jiang also proposed a dedicated U.S.-China military hotline for AI incidents, warning that automated cyber exchanges could escalate too quickly for human intervention.

One country's defensive AI might automatically respond to suspicious activity, while the other side could interpret that response as an attack and retaliate before understanding what actually happened.

A hotline could allow one government to tell the other that an unusual AI operation was accidental, unauthorised or still under investigation before it was treated as deliberate state action.

However, experts including Carla Freeman at ​Johns Hopkins School of Advanced International Studies have ​questioned the utility of the existing U.S.-China military ⁠crisis communication hotline, citing Chinese officials' refusal to answer U.S. counterparts' calls about the "[spy balloon incident](https://www.reuters.com/world/china-balloon-soaring-over-us-deflates-hopes-diplomatic-thaw-2023-02-04/)" in February 2023.

The Chinese bureaucracy's rigid top-down hierarchy also disempowers low-ranking officers from taking the initiative during engagements with U.S. counterparts, she wrote in an article for War on the Rocks in January.

"No one in the ​Chinese system wants to communicate with the United States until the top leadership in consultation with relevant actors within China's party-state have decided on ​a response, which may take ⁠days if not longer," she said.

## VIEWS IN WASHINGTON AND BEIJING

Neither government has publicly endorsed the Brookings-Tsinghua proposals, but China has increasingly placed AI inside its existing arms-control bureaucracy.

AI is a formal portfolio of the Foreign Ministry's Department of Arms Control, which also handles nuclear weapons, non-proliferation, missiles and other international security issues.

Shen Jian, China's ambassador for disarmament affairs, told a U.N. meeting in Geneva in June that military AI could affect strategic stability ⁠and raise risks ​of miscalculation and conflict escalation, and that weapons should remain under human control. China also argues that AI safety should ​not become a pretext for technological barriers.

Washington has no equivalent single arms-control home for AI, with national security policy spread across the White House National Security Council, State Department, Pentagon and other agencies.

Both governments remain wary of measures that could slow their ​own technological development. Trump has warned broad restraints could hand [China an advantage](https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/trump-says-very-negative-forces-raising-exaggerated-concerns-over-ai-2026-09-13/), while Beijing views many U.S. technology controls as attempts to preserve American dominance.

Reporting by Eduardo Baptista and Laurie Chen; Editing by Jamie Freed

Our Standards: [The Thomson Reuters Trust Principles., opens new tab](https://www.thomsonreuters.com/en/about-us/trust-principles.html)

Eduardo Baptista is Chief Technology Correspondent, Greater China, for Reuters, based in Beijing. He covers artificial intelligence, semiconductors and emerging technologies. He holds a BA in History from the University of Cambridge.

Laurie Chen is a China Correspondent at Reuters in Beijing, whose coverage focuses on the nexus of frontier technology, strategic emerging industries and geopolitics. She has reported on China for almost a decade, having previously covered China's government, defence, security and foreign policy. She has broken multiple global scoops on U.S.-China relations and the trade war 2.0, elite Chinese politics and diplomacy. She is particularly interested in Chinese frontier AI, tech and industrial policy, semiconductor supply chains, robotics, aerospace and grand strategy.

title: The Limits of Trump and Xi’s Photo-Op Summit
summary: The leaders of the world’s two most powerful countries did not resolve any of the major issues facing the U.S.-China relationship. But that does not mean the meeting was a complete failure. ## By experts and staff Published September 27, 20
content:
The leaders of the world’s two most powerful countries did not resolve any of the major issues facing the U.S.-China relationship. But that does not mean the meeting was a complete failure.

## By experts and staff

Published September 27, 2026 7:10 p.m.

*   ![Image 1](https://assets.cfr.org/images/t_cfr_1_1/f_auto/w_1024/v1772036608/0044_David-Sacks-112_3862056c977/0044_David-Sacks-112_3862056c977.png)

_David Sacks is a fellow for Asia studies whose work focuses on U.S.-China relations, U.S.-Taiwan relations, Chinese foreign policy, and cross-Strait relations._

It is by now a cliché to note that meetings between U.S. President Donald Trump and Chinese leader Xi Jinping are high on symbolism and low on substance. Xi’s visit to Washington this week, though, may have set a new high-water mark for symbolism and a new low for substance. Trump and Xi did not reach a consensus on any of the major geopolitical issues in which they find themselves on opposing sides, make headway in regulating the development of artificial intelligence (AI), or place the bilateral economic relationship on a more sustainable trajectory. Indeed, the only clear winner to emerge from the discussions was Zoo Atlanta, which is set to receive two giant pandas.

The tone for Xi’s visit was set at Joint Base Andrews, where Trump eagerly awaited his guest’s arrival. Members of the U.S. military literally smoothed the red carpet for Xi, who received the distinction of becoming the first foreign head of state to be greeted at Andrews by a U.S. president (aside from papal arrivals) in over six decades. Notably, Xi did not extend the same courtesy when Trump visited Beijing in May. Trump’s decision to bestow such an honor reflects his belief that a strong personal bond with Xi can effectively paper over the major structural issues between the United States and China. China, for its part, will use these optics to make the case that it is now an equal of the United States and should be treated accordingly. According to China’s [readout](https://www.fmprc.gov.cn/eng/xw/zyxw/202609/t20260926_12031663.html), the visit resulted in eight modest deliverables. The Trump administration’s [fact sheet](https://www.whitehouse.gov/fact-sheets/2026/09/fact-sheet-president-donald-j-trump-advances-a-fair-and-reciprocal-relationship-with-china-while-hosting-historic-state-visit/) did not directly repeat these eight deliverables.

In the economic realm, according to the Trump administration, the two sides identified $30 billion of nonsensitive goods in each direction that could enjoy reduced tariffs. China also agreed to import at least ten million metric tons of coal from the United States in both 2027 and 2028. The two countries also established a U.S.-China Board of Investment. The Chinese readout, however, did not mention the coal purchases or the Board of Investment.

Trump and Xi also agreed to extend by two months, to January 10, 2027, the one-year economic truce that took effect in November 2025. Under the terms of that agreement, the United States reduced tariffs on Chinese goods and China pledged to restore U.S. access to rare earths, purchase twenty-five million metric tons of U.S. soybeans a year, along with other agricultural products, and crack down on the export of precursors used to manufacture fentanyl. Despite this agreement, Chinese exports of rare earths to the United States [remain below](https://www.ft.com/content/eeef7db4-b26d-426f-896b-f7b95bb84223?syn-25a6b1a6=1) their historical levels, and the Trump administration noted “U.S. concerns regarding supply chain shortages related to rare earths and other critical minerals.” A major question moving forward is whether Chinese exports of rare earths bounce back in the coming months or remain depressed.

The summit did not yield any breakthroughs on AI, which has emerged as perhaps the most talked-about and consequential facet of U.S.-China relations. Those who fear that humans could soon lose control of advanced AI models have been urging the United States and China, as the world’s two leading AI powers, to agree to slow the pace of development and establish safeguards. Others have urged the Trump administration to pressure China to curb distillation, an AI training technique for copying a rival model’s outputs. Beijing, for its part, wants Washington to ease export controls on the most sophisticated semiconductors, which are needed to develop and train advanced AI models. In the end, the two sides agreed to establish a U.S.-China AI dialogue, with the next meeting scheduled to take place in November, and to create a bilateral communication channel for AI incidents. Trump seemed more focused on getting China to agree to rebrand AI as “super intelligence.” According to the U.S. fact sheet, Trump and Xi “agreed to use the term ‘super intelligence,’” although China has not adopted this new naming convention.

Geopolitical differences seem to have been left on the back burner. Trump and Xi agreed that Iran should not develop a nuclear weapon and that tolls cannot be levied on international waterways.According to U.S. Ambassador to China David Perdue, [Trump reiterated to Xi](https://www.cnbc.com/video/2026/09/25/u-s-amb-to-china-david-perdue-on-trump-xi-summit-ai-arms-race-and-u-s-china-trade-relations.html) that any Chinese assistance to Iran would be “totally unacceptable” and Xi “assured him that changes had been made.” The two sides did not announce anything notable pertaining to Russia’s war against Ukraine or North Korea’s nuclear weapons program.

### Buying time

Xi, unsurprisingly, raised Taiwan during his meetings with Trump. Xi’s [statement](https://www.fmprc.gov.cn/eng/xw/zyxw/202609/t20260925_12031181.html) noted, “It is hoped that the U.S. side will adhere to the correct position of opposing ‘Taiwan independence,’ and handle the Taiwan question with caution, so as to lay a solid foundation for China-U.S. strategic cooperation and the development of bilateral relations.” Calling on Trump to “persist” (坚持) in opposing Taiwan independence—a more accurate rendering than the official English translation’s softer “adhere to”—indicates that from Beijing’s perspective Trump has already altered U.S. policy and the task is for him to maintain this course. Xi also cast U.S. policy toward Taiwan as a prerequisite for laying “a solid foundation” for the bilateral relationship.

Despite this messaging in the days leading up to the summit and during the summit itself, Taiwan was not featured in either side’s end-of-summit readouts. Trump did not yield to China’s pressure to explicitly oppose Taiwan independence, while administration officials stated that U.S. policy toward Taiwan remains unchanged.

While Taipei will likely find this reassuring, it will be more concerned about the fate of the pending [$14 billion U.S. arms sale](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/09/21/world/asia/china-trump-taiwan-arms-sales.html). Beijing aims to delay this sale indefinitely, which would deepen doubts in Taiwan about U.S. reliability and delay the arrival of important weapons. Perdue noted in an [interview](https://www.foxnews.com/video/6405700393112) after the summit that Trump and Xi “talk about that every time they get together” and that Trump even asked Xi if he would like to buy U.S. weapons in the future. With Xi and Trump agreeing to meet again at the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) leaders’ meeting in Shenzhen in November and at the Group of Twenty (G20) summit in Miami in December, China is likely confident that it can delay any U.S. arms sale to Taiwan into 2027.

Trump and Xi did not achieve meaningful progress on any of the major issues in the bilateral relationship. But that is not to say that the summit was a complete failure. Both leaders oversee top-heavy systems, making discussions between the two of them even more important. For now, they seem content with attending summits that do not resolve the points of friction and kicking many cans down the road. Both are playing for time: for Trump, to wean the United States off Chinese rare earths, and for Xi, to overcome dependence on U.S. high-tech products.

Given the array of sensitive geopolitical issues, from Iran to North Korea, Taiwan, and Ukraine, communicating bottom lines and clearing up potential misunderstandings are critical. To the extent that regular meetings allow Trump and Xi to clearly convey their positions and get a better sense of the other side’s perspective, they should be encouraged. Whether Trump actually uses such meetings to do so, however, remains an open question.

title: Hundreds of thousands in Paris cheer Pope Leo in largest event of French tour
summary: * Summary * Pope Leo is visiting France through Monday * Estimated 800,000 crowd at outdoor Mass with pope on Saturday * First US pope warns that UN, global diplomacy in crisis * Trip comes five years after report on abuse by clergy PARIS,
content:
*   Summary

*   Pope Leo is visiting France through Monday
*   Estimated 800,000 crowd at outdoor Mass with pope on Saturday
*   First US pope warns that UN, global diplomacy in crisis
*   Trip comes five years after report on abuse by clergy

PARIS, Sept 26 (Reuters) - Crowds stretched the length of the Avenue des Champs-Élysées in Paris on Saturday, as [Pope Leo](https://www.reuters.com/world/pope/) urged Catholics to find happiness in faith, ‌not material things, at the biggest event of his [visit to France](https://www.reuters.com/world/pope-leo-heads-france-with-ai-apologies-clergy-abuse-agenda-2026-09-25/), an outdoor Mass with an estimated 800,000 people.

Chants of "Leo, Leo" and "Long live the Pope" echoed down the roughly 2 km (1.2 miles) tree-lined boulevard, from the Place de la Concorde to the Arc de Triomphe, as people pressed against security barriers for a glimpse of Leo as he arrived in an open-top popemobile.

Get a look at the day ahead in European and global markets with the Morning Bid Europe newsletter. Sign up [here.](https://www.reuters.com/newsletters/morning-bid-europe/?location=article-paragraph&redirectUrl=%2Fworld%2Feurope%2Fpope-leo-set-largest-event-france-tour-paris-crowds-swell-2026-09-26%2F)

The vehicle ​paused frequently as people waved white and yellow Vatican flags and Leo blessed people with disabilities, children and babies passed forward by volunteers.

Attendees included Brigitte ​Macron, the French president's wife, far-right leader Marine Le Pen, who is leading in the polls ahead of next year's presidential ⁠election, Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu and Bernard Arnault, the billionaire chairman of French luxury group LVMH.

Cheers rang out in the crowd as Leo thanked God in his ​sermon for the chance to visit France on a whirlwind four-day, three-city tour, during which he is seeking to repair the Church's standing after [abuse scandals](https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/french-victims-clerical-abuse-hope-popes-visit-can-deepen-church-reform-2026-09-22/) caused nationwide shock.

The ​pope told Catholics that only their faith would provide true happiness.

"Only God can fill the emptiness within us," said the pope.

Benoit Dedieu-Anglade, 67, said after the Mass that he had been impressed by the speech.

"We must not give in to the easy path or distractions — and I was moved by how he expressed this in such clear, lucid French," he said.

## PRAISE FOR POPE'S PEACE ​MESSAGE

Attendees began assembling before sunrise to hear the pontiff speak at the mid-afternoon Mass.

Item 1 of 5 Pope Leo waves from the popemobile on his way to the Place de la Concorde to celebrate an open-air Mass, during his four-day apostolic journey to France, in Paris, France, September 26, 2026. REUTERS/Remo Casilli

**[1/5]**Pope Leo waves from the popemobile on his way to the Place de la Concorde to celebrate an open-air Mass, during his four-day apostolic journey to France, in Paris, France, September 26, 2026. REUTERS/Remo Casilli [Purchase Licensing Rights, opens new tab](https://www.reutersconnect.com/item/pope-leo-visits-france/dGFnOnJldXRlcnMuY29tLDIwMjY6bmV3c21sX1JDMjFSTkFKUjI1MA%3D%3D/?utm_medium=rcom-article-media&utm_campaign=rcom-rcp-lead)

The pope, who has forcefully decried the direction of global leadership in recent months, ​warned in a speech on Friday at the Paris headquarters of the UN culture and education body, UNESCO, that the UN and other multilateral groups [were in crisis](https://www.reuters.com/world/pope-leo-heads-france-with-ai-apologies-clergy-abuse-agenda-2026-09-25/).

He also repeated his frequent ‌appeal for ⁠the world to reconsider the development of [artificial intelligence](https://www.reuters.com/business/pope-leo-risk-an-ai-apocalypse-is-major-concern-2026-09-24/), telling French leaders that AI could create a future where "a paradise of machines" takes control of the Earth.

He has also frequently spoken out for peace, including in remarks with French leaders at the Elysee on Friday, with his comments criticising the Iran war earlier this year drawing a rebuke from US President [Donald Trump](https://www.reuters.com/world/us/donald-trump/).

Pierre-Marie Estienne, 36, was in the crowd for Leo's Mass in central Paris with his wife and their four young children.

"We live in an era ​of great materialism," he said before Leo ​arrived. "There is a lot of evil ⁠around us, so we need a message of hope and love."

## POPE VISITS NEWLY BAPTISED CATHOLICS

France, a secular nation where the separation of church and state is enshrined in a 1905 law, has witnessed a steady decline in affiliation to the Catholic Church ​since World War Two, mirroring a trend in other traditionally Catholic countries.

Although the French Bishops' Conference points to an ​increase in baptisms of ⁠adults, including a record 21,000 last Easter, a report published by the official statistics agency, INSEE, showed that only 25% of French 18-to-49-year-olds identified as Catholic, compared with 43% a decade earlier.

In a visit on Saturday with newly baptised Catholics at the Catholic University of Paris before the Mass, Leo urged the French church not to be "naively optimistic" about ⁠the recent increase ​in adherents.

"We must recognise, welcome and protect the small flame that the Holy Spirit has kindled ​in the darkness of the night, the tiny seed that strives to grow even amid the thorns," he said.

Leo heads later on Saturday to Lourdes, home to a Catholic shrine. He will meet seven French ​victims of abuse by clergy there on Sunday.

Updates crowd size estimation in paragraph 1, adds quote from attendee 8-9, detail paragraph 10

content:
华盛顿 —

在中国国家主席习近平访问美国并将于星期四(9月24日)在白宫与美国总统唐纳德·特朗普会谈前夕，美国国会及行政当局中国委员会(CECC)星期二举行听证会。来自两党的议员、被中国关押者家属以及宗教和人权团体代表，敦促特朗普总统把释放在押人士、人权和宗教自由列为美中峰会的核心议题。

这场听证会题为“镇压的面孔：遭中共针对的囚犯、家庭和社群”。听证会聚焦中国在押人士、长期在华服刑的美国公民，以及基督徒、维吾尔人和法轮功修炼者所面临的待遇，同时讨论针对海外倡议人士的威胁、监视、法律骚扰和亲属施压。

委员会共同主席、共和党籍联邦众议员克里斯·史密斯(Chris Smith)在开场陈述中说：“沉默不是选项。”

“今天，我们呼吁习近平释放有良知的善良人士，以实际行动展现善意、仁慈、尊重与力量，”史密斯议员说，“我们再次请求曾帮助金明日牧师重获自由的特朗普总统，敦促习近平展现同情心与勇气。”

史密斯把这次美中领导人会晤称为特朗普就相关个案大胆发声的“黄金机会”。他在回应被关押者家属的证词时说，“对每天在劳改营、监狱或看守所受苦的人来说，每一天都是煎熬”。

曾经担任CECC主席的民主党籍联邦众议员吉姆·麦戈文(Jim McGovern)也敦促特朗普推动释放中国的良心犯，并称中国近期无罪释放金明日牧师证明直接交涉能够产生结果。

“交易可以让一名、甚至一批良心犯获释...但我们的目标应该更加广泛，”麦戈文说，“根本目标必须是从一开始就确保不让人们遭到不公正监禁。因此，我们不能在外交政策中放弃人权。”

来自弗吉尼亚州的民主党籍联邦众议员苏哈斯·苏布拉马尼亚姆(Suhas Subramanyam)表示，维持外交关系与提出人权问题并不冲突。

“把侵犯人权问题、民众受到的待遇以及海外美国公民受到的待遇置于议程核心，并不意味着必须牺牲双边和多边关系，”他说。

史密斯在会后对美国之音说，尤其是国务卿马尔科· 卢比奥(Marco Rubio)和特朗普总统，应该更公开、更突出地谈论人权，把它摆在最重要的位置。

“一个国家如何对待或者虐待自己的人民，是判断我们能否相信它会遵守贸易协议或任何其他协议的最重要指标。正如人们常说的，这是‘煤矿里的金丝雀’，是一种预警信号。如果你连自己的人民都不尊重，或者像这次这样，连身在中国的美国人也不尊重，甚至把他们关进监狱，我们又怎么能在其他任何事情上信任你？所以对我而言，人权至关重要，”他对美国之音说。

**金明日获释 八名教会同工仍被关押**

北京锡安教会创办人金明日在听证会上作证说，他于2025年10月在中国政府针对锡安教会的抓捕行动中被拘押。今年7月，检方撤回对他的起诉，他随后获释并回到美国与家人团聚。

金明日说，他后来从美国领事官员处得知，特朗普曾向习近平提出他的案件。他将自己的获释视为美国政府高层直接交涉取得的结果。

目前仍有八名锡安教会同工被关押，其家属对羁押环境、营养、医疗和虐待问题表示担忧。

金明日对美国之音说，“我觉得现在是最好的时机，不能再推后了，因为中国的人权状况越来越恶劣，现在是真正需要关注的时候。我希望这次两国元首的会晤也在人权问题、宗教自由问题上有一些突破。”

他希望这次峰会能让更多牧师和教会人士重获自由。

史密斯和麦戈文都把金明日获释视为一个可以复制的先例，同时强调个别人士获释并不代表中国整体人权状况已经改变。

**家属向两国领导人发出直接呼吁**

维吾尔活动人士茹仙·阿巴斯(Rushan Abbas)在证词中说，她2018年在华盛顿公开谈论维吾尔人处境数天后，她的姐姐、退休医生古丽仙·阿巴斯(Gulshan Abbas)被中国当局拘押，后来被判处20年监禁。茹仙认为，姐姐遭关押是中国政府对她在美国公开发声的报复。

茹仙对美国之音中说：“我姐姐不是政治人物。她之所以身陷囹圄，只是因为我公开发声。”

她希望特朗普在与习近平会晤时直接提出她姐姐的案件，并争取让她获得人道或医疗假释。

另一名证人、美国退伍军人老纳尔逊·威尔斯(Nelson Wells, Sr)说，他的儿子小纳尔逊·威尔斯(Nelson A. Wells, Jr)自2014年起在中国服刑。据老威尔斯的证词，他的儿子替一名自认为是朋友的人携带包裹，被中国当局指控包裹内含有非法毒品。

威尔斯说，儿子的健康状况已经严重恶化。他在听证会上分别向特朗普和习近平发出“父亲对父亲”的呼吁。

他说，“特朗普总统，我以父亲对父亲的身份来找您。纳尔逊已经是成年人了，但他仍然是我的孩子。我不能把儿子留在身后。习主席，我也以父亲的身份向您呼吁。纳尔逊已经在监狱里待了12年多。他病了。他的家人受了苦。让他在狱中死去没有任何正义。请多留情。纳尔逊最小的女儿12岁。她从未在照片之外见过父亲。她每晚都为他祈祷，也为能带他回家的人祈祷。特朗普总统，习主席，你们可以成为那样的人。我们最深切的希望就是让纳尔逊回家。”

同场作证的蒂姆·亨特(Tim Hunt)呼吁中国当局基于人道理由释放他的姐姐、美国公民道恩·米歇尔·亨特(Dawn Michelle Hunt)。

道恩自2014年起被关押在广东省女子监狱。她的哥哥蒂姆·亨特作证说，道恩当年收到一封中奖邮件，以为自己赢得了前往香港的旅行。此后，行程组织者安排她进入中国大陆，并赠送她高级手袋。道恩准备离境时，机场安检人员在组织者交给她的手袋夹层中发现毒品。

家属称，道恩是跨国贩毒骗局的受害者，并不知道手袋内藏有毒品。她本人也一直否认走私指控。中国法院判定她走私毒品罪名成立，2017年判处她死刑、缓期两年执行，之后减为无期徒刑。美国国会及行政当局中国委员会表示，这起案件的审理缺乏正当程序。

蒂姆说道恩的健康状况正在恶化，患有严重的妇科疾病，但因不信任监狱医疗条件而拒绝接受子宫切除手术。她的父亲今年1月去世，直到生命最后一刻也未能等到女儿回家。

蒂姆在听证会上呼吁特朗普亲自向习近平提出道恩的案件。“请不要再让一年、一个生日或一个节日过去，”他说，“请不要让又一位家人在道恩回家前离世。”

**“迫害被输出到海外”**

法轮功发言人张而平在听证会上敦促特朗普政府在习近平访美期间，同时提出中国境内的宗教迫害和发生在美国的跨国镇压问题。

他说，“在习近平即将访美期间，我们呼吁美国政府提出法轮功在中国境内持续遭受迫害的问题、针对美国法轮功修炼者的跨国镇压，并要求释放那些仅仅因为信仰而被关押的人。这样的交涉将重申美国对人权、国家安全以及保护本国公民的承诺。”

张而平在听证会后对美国之音说，他所关注的已经不只是中国境内的宗教迫害，还包括这些做法被延伸到海外，进行跨国镇压。

“它(中国)到了美国的自由社会，利用美国法治社会的社会机制，来行使它在中国大陆所做的事情，这是不能容忍的，”他说，“自由国家是保护自由公民的，不能把(美国法治)这个平台变成迫害美国人的(平台)。”

茹仙·阿巴斯也在证词中指控，中国政府通过向境内亲属施压，以及网络攻击、监视、威胁和虚假信息等方式，试图让海外维吾尔活动人士噤声。她说，姐姐的案件向海外维吾尔人传递的信息是：“如果你公开发声，你的家人就会付出代价。”

中国当局一再否认有关新疆存在“种族灭绝”的指控，并称中国”依法保障公民的宗教信仰自由“。

史密斯说，委员会将把听证会证词转交卢比奥国务卿和白宫，并要求美方在特朗普与习近平会晤期间把这些在押人士的案件置于议程前列。

# [Chinese Hackers Exploit Chrome-Windows Zero-Day Chain to Deploy CLEANGULP Malware](https://thehackernews.com/2026/09/chinese-hackers-exploit-chrome-windows.html)

__ Ravie Lakshmanan __ Sep 23, 2026 Zero-Day / Vulnerability

[![Image 5](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEikVEmuPJKZAlboodZWejG4dGZXXejOLThyXPoOnycqTY8lznAewTW5ovv8XFJzhyjPRMXT-njudYOVWFEYCLvmEPDyUrfDTZzAmp1S4KE4DuzsDFxt8R-biL2puZZBWG36_dkhfzvpeigcPb9WJNy31oIXo6Oh3zMUzL3JG6MEr4OaGE4Yi_k5JCpohVrZ/s1700-nu-rw-lo-l85-e365/windows-china.jpg)](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEikVEmuPJKZAlboodZWejG4dGZXXejOLThyXPoOnycqTY8lznAewTW5ovv8XFJzhyjPRMXT-njudYOVWFEYCLvmEPDyUrfDTZzAmp1S4KE4DuzsDFxt8R-biL2puZZBWG36_dkhfzvpeigcPb9WJNy31oIXo6Oh3zMUzL3JG6MEr4OaGE4Yi_k5JCpohVrZ/s1700-nu-rw-lo-l85-e365/windows-china.jpg)

A Chinese threat actor codenamed **UTA0565** has been observed exploiting the recently disclosed Google Chrome-Microsoft Windows exploit chain as zero-days through fake websites.

The attacks, detected on September 3 and 4, 2026, involved the [chaining](https://thehackernews.com/2026/09/china-linked-hackers-exploit-chrome.html) of two vulnerabilities in Chrome (CVE-2026-85046, CVE-2026-87491) and one impacting Windows Advanced Local Procedure Call (CVE-2026-85880) to break out of the browser's sandbox and achieve remote code execution.

"UTA0565 masqueraded as various entities including media organizations and a non-governmental organization (NGO)," Volexity researchers Damien Cash and Tom Lancaster [said](https://www.volexity.com/blog/2026/09/21/mind-the-patch-gap-part-2-fake-websites-used-to-deploy-chrome-windows-0-day-exploits/) in an analysis published this week. "Notably, this threat actor's campaigns differed from previously documented attacks by using multiple fake websites to deceive victims."

One such campaign targeted Asian government entities with Chinese- and English-language phishing emails that urged recipients to support Hong Kong activist [Chow Hang-tung](https://www.nchrd.org/2025/10/joint-ngo-letter-to-demand-immediate-and-unconditional-release-of-chow-hang-tung-and-lee-cheuk-yan/) and masqueraded as the Center for American Progress (CAP). Chow was [sentenced](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cvgyvk2djk4o) to seven years and three months in prison earlier this month.

[![Image 6: Cybersecurity](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEhJkE4t8oCql1wmWVt687J1yD7WnYRqvIpcsUwFSVUO-0HpxZWMCxLmeYwBlz38-C0KD-R6f9Pg0swgPTQuBsNXck_Kl3iKWNSQtyMcDNUSZGhiBd_XFu6U1SQi5LhuW-FHg00iT3CbRCUgMoCwhZevwxp8-9gwM2wZVVtGVO8Z2NbZ5EjVmI2dH4adnSAk/s728-nu-rw-lo-l85-e365/Shai-Hulud-d.jpg)](https://thehackernews.uk/event-security-need)

These messages contained spoofed links pointing to "chinadigitaltimes[.]top" and "americanprgoress[.]top," which replicated the look of China Digital Times and CAP, while loading an additional HTML element via a hidden iframe.

The HTML element ("config.html") is said to have used the same [BlueMoon](https://thehackernews.com/2026/09/four-spy-groups-used-same-chrome-and.html) exploit kit combining CVE-2026-85046, CVE-2026-87491, and CVE-2026-85880, with the final "pp" shellcode downloading an executable named "chrome_cleanup.exe" from the bogus domain. The payload is a malware family dubbed CLEANGULP, which is built using the Microsoft Visual C Compiler.

It supports the following capabilities -

*   shell, to run a command
*   ps, to list running processes
*   upload, to upload a file
*   download, to download a file
*   bof, to execute a Execution of a beacon object file ([BOF](https://hstechdocs.helpsystems.com/manuals/cobaltstrike/current/userguide/content/topics/beacon-object-files_main.htm))

Interestingly, CLEANGULP has been found to use a hard-coded domain named "thecovnresation[.]com" for command-and-control (C2) over HTTP, indicating an attempt to mimic "[theconversation[.]com](https://theconversation.com/)," a non-profit media outlet known for publishing academic research, analysis, and commentary.

"This seemingly widespread adoption across multiple threat actors suggests a coordinated effort within the Chinese CNE community, where the core kit was likely shared, customized, and weaponized by multiple groups," Volexity said. "The activity reported so far reflects only two organizations' observations; the full scope and impact are likely far broader."

title: Merz clings on after German election 'disaster'
summary: * Summary * Companies * Merz's party suffers historic loss in regional election * No immediate challenge to Merz * Far-left could take power in state of Berlin * AfD has second electoral success in a month BERLIN, Sept 21 (Reuters) - Chance
content:
*   Summary
*   Companies

*   Merz's party suffers historic loss in regional election
*   No immediate challenge to Merz
*   Far-left could take power in state of Berlin
*   AfD has second electoral success in a month

BERLIN, Sept 21 (Reuters) - Chancellor Friedrich Merz was clinging to power on Monday after his conservative party [tumbled](https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/merz-under-pressure-two-more-german-states-go-polls-2026-09-20/) to its worst regional election defeat in postwar Germany and ​members of his coalition clashed over his unpopular [reform agenda](https://www.reuters.com/business/finance/germanys-merz-unveils-pension-tax-labour-reforms-2026-07-02/).

Merz himself described Sunday's loss in the northeastern state of Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania as a "disaster" as his party for ‌the first time missed the 5% threshold for entering a state parliament. This even occurred in a state that was the former stronghold of Merz's predecessor and party rival, Angela Merkel.

The Misinformation Monitor newsletter rounds up international misinformation narratives, with a "Real or Fake?" quiz in every edition. Sign up [here.](https://www.reuters.com/newsletters/misinformation-monitor/?location=article-paragraph&redirectUrl=%2Fworld%2Fmerz-clings-after-german-election-disaster-2026-09-21%2F)

The far-right Alternative for Germany (AfD) took first place. While it fell well short of a majority, it was the second time the party had topped a state election within a month, which it sees as building momentum towards national power.

Merz's party also ​bled votes in a second election in the state of Berlin, which could see the [far-left Die Linke party](https://www.reuters.com/world/far-left-party-wins-berlin-election-pledging-nationalise-housing-2026-09-20/), the descendants of the Communist party that once ran East ​Germany, take power in a coalition after winning most seats.

## GERMAN CHANCELLOR'S FUTURE IN THE BALANCE

Sunday's results may not prove a knock-out blow for ⁠Merz, but his low approval ratings and the AfD's surge have left his future [in the balance](https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/merzs-fate-balance-second-eastern-german-state-goes-polls-2026-09-16/).

Several conservative state premiers met on Sunday to take stock after publicly backing Merz in an ​open letter last week.

"The meeting was not about a revolt or a plot against Chancellor Merz," one of the participants of the meeting told Reuters.

"However, there was agreement that the Chancellor needs ​to deliver more following the CDU's difficult results in the state elections."

Within minutes of the results coming in on Sunday, Merz in televised remarks vowed to press on with his reform agenda that he says is vital to revive sluggish growth in Europe's largest economy and keep it globally competitive.

But members of his centre-left coalition partner, the Social Democrats, pushed back. That includes Manuela Schwesig, the popular incumbent state premier of Mecklenburg-Western ​Pomerania, who has sharply criticised the federal government's pension reforms.

Schwesig said she was "very irritated" by Merz's remarks. "I think more humility is actually called for on the part of the Chancellor," ​she told the ARD broadcaster.

The economy has been struggling since the pandemic to regain momentum, with competition from China as well as higher energy prices challenging its export-driven economic model.

Item 1 of 3 German Chancellor Friedrich Merz gives a statement after first exit polls of the Berlin and Mecklenburg Western Pomerania state elections, at the CDU headquarters in Berlin, Germany, September 20, 2026. REUTERS/Christian Mang

**[1/3]**German Chancellor Friedrich Merz gives a statement after first exit polls of the Berlin and Mecklenburg Western Pomerania state elections, at the CDU headquarters in Berlin, Germany, September 20, 2026. REUTERS/Christian Mang [Purchase Licensing Rights, opens new tab](https://www.reutersconnect.com/item/german-chancellor-friedrich-merz-gives-a-statement-at-the-cdu-headquarters-in-berlin/dGFnOnJldXRlcnMuY29tLDIwMjY6bmV3c21sX1JDMjROTkE3N0FBRA%3D%3D/?utm_medium=rcom-article-media&utm_campaign=rcom-rcp-lead)

Some business leaders urged Merz to ‌stay the ⁠course.

"Economic strength is not built by waiting, but by actively shaping the future. We cannot afford to lose momentum now," said Jochen Hanebeck, the CEO of chipmaker Infineon

, in a LinkedIn post.

## BITTER PILL FOR GERMANY'S IMMIGRANT COMMUNITIES

The AfD party leads in national opinion polls but has been kept from power by the other main parties' refusal to work with it, in a policy known as the "firewall" that has been increasingly scrutinised as the AfD gained strength. Its hardline stance on immigration has left some in Germany of migrant background [questioning their future](https://www.reuters.com/world/far-right-triumph-eastern-germany-leaves-migrants-questioning-their-future-2026-09-07/).

"The fact that the AfD is ​in the lead is quite a bitter ​pill to swallow," said Yasmin Goudarzi, an ⁠educational scientist.

In Berlin, Die Linke topped the polls in a state election for the first time on a campaign to nationalise housing from corporate landlords and put a cap on rents, echoing the rise of New York Mayor [Zohran Mamdani](https://www.reuters.com/world/us/mamdanis-sweep-new-york-political-earthquake-among-democrats-2026-06-24/).

Merz, who was elected last year on a promise ​to return Germany to growth, has struggled to win over voters, as a stream of communication missteps served to compound resentment over ​unpopular pension, tax and healthcare ⁠reforms.

Schwesig, sometimes seen as a potential next SPD national leader, is likely to remain in power in her state.

Schwesig said the AfD had won votes by criticising [Germany's support for Ukraine](https://www.reuters.com/world/german-foreign-minister-says-kyiv-should-buy-more-arms-german-companies-2026-09-08/), a message that the [Kremlin also capitalised on](https://www.reuters.com/world/kremlin-says-afds-victory-germany-due-large-part-lack-cheap-russian-gas-2026-09-21/) in comments by its spokesperson on Monday.

The AfD wants to restore ties with Moscow and characterises sanctions on Russia as self-sabotaging, by cutting off access to Russia's vast cheap ⁠energy resources.

Schwesig had ​at one time supported the Nord Stream pipelines carrying Russian gas through her Baltic Sea coast state into ​Germany before they were blown up in 2022, but later changed her position.

"The troublemakers who voted for the AfD clearly weren't paying attention in history class," said Detlef Spelker, a passerby in Schwerin.

"We've been in a similar situation before, ​almost 100 years ago. Inflation, problems with jobs, nobody had any money. We'll see what this brings now."

Reporting by Andreas Rinke, Matthias Williams, Hakan Ersen; Writing by Matthias Williams Editing by Alexandra Hudson

title: After deaths of nine women, South Africans gather to run, mourn and demand change
summary: * Summary * Bodies of nine women found near Johannesburg * Killings have reignited anger over violence against women * Policing weakened by corruption and lack of resources JOHANNESBURG, Sept 19 (Reuters) - South Africans gathered for memor
content:
*   Summary

*   Bodies of nine women found near Johannesburg
*   Killings have reignited anger over violence against women
*   Policing weakened by corruption and lack of resources

JOHANNESBURG, Sept 19 (Reuters) - South Africans gathered for memorial runs and protests this week after ​the killings of nine women near Johannesburg reignited anger and fear over violence that many ‌say mirrors the dangers women face every day.

Police have found the [bodies of nine women](https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/south-african-police-find-ninth-womans-body-near-johannesburg-2026-09-17/) in Ekurhuleni, east of Johannesburg, over the past two months and are investigating whether the killings are linked.

The Reuters Daily Briefing newsletter provides all the news you need to start your day. Sign up [here.](https://www.reuters.com/newsletters/daily-briefing/?location=article-paragraph&redirectUrl=%2Fworld%2Fafrica%2Fafter-deaths-nine-women-south-africans-gather-run-mourn-demand-change-2026-09-19%2F)

Most of the victims were in their 20s and ​30s. Some were found stripped of their clothes and showed signs of sexual assault.

A memorial run ​in Johannesburg on Saturday morning honoured one of the victims, Elizabeth Moselakgomo, who ⁠disappeared after going for a run and was found dead days later. Runners lit candles and carried ​a banner reading: "Enough. Stop Femicide."

"We are here because we've lost a runner. But we are not safe anywhere," ​said Lerato Lentsela, one of dozens of people who dressed in black for the memorial run.

"We are not safe running, we are not safe at a post office, we are not safe on a date, we are not safe in ​our own homes, we are not safe in an Uber."

Item 1 of 3 A student holds a placard at the University of Cape Town during a vigil for victims of gender-based violence and femicide, while calling for stronger action against violence against women following a spate of killings in recent months around Johannesburg, in Cape Town, South Africa, September 18, 2026. REUTERS/Esa Alexander

**[1/3]**A student holds a placard at the University of Cape Town during a vigil for victims of gender-based violence and femicide, while calling for stronger action against violence against women following a spate of killings in recent months around Johannesburg, in Cape Town, South Africa, September 18,... [Purchase Licensing Rights, opens new tab](https://www.reutersconnect.com/item/a-vigil-for-victims-of-gender-based-violence-and-femicide-in-cape-town/dGFnOnJldXRlcnMuY29tLDIwMjY6bmV3c21sX1JDMlVMTkFTUDJHMQ%3D%3D/?utm_medium=rcom-article-media&utm_campaign=rcom-rcp-lead)Read more

The killings have reignited anger over violence against ​women in South Africa, where gender-based violence was declared a national

[disaster in 2025, opens new tab](https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/nRTVx8hNz)
. Many women say the heightened attention and ‌official ⁠promises have done little to make them feel safer.

"Enough is enough. Our women deserve to live, walk, run and exist without fear," the Uyinene Mrwetyana Foundation, a charity that campaigns against gender-based violence, said in a statement.

President Cyril Ramaphosa said on Thursday that South Africa could not allow itself to grow accustomed to ​such violence and pledged that ​no stone would be ⁠left unturned in the investigations.

But policing in South Africa is weakened by corruption and lack of resources. Only about [one in 10 murders](https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/soccer-stars-murder-highlights-south-africas-crime-problem-election-nears-2024-05-02/) is ever solved.

"We need ​to relook at our policing. The only reason these nine women were found ​was because ⁠there was more police presence in the area. This problem is countrywide," said Merlize Jogiat of Women for Change, which held a memorial event in Cape Town on Friday.

Some women also criticised police advice urging them to ⁠take extra ​precautions when exercising or walking alone.

"Stop placing the responsibility of ​our safety back onto us," Women for Change said in a social media post. "Women should not have to organise their entire lives ​around surviving violence and not being next."

Reporting by Nellie Peyton and Thando Hlope; Editing by Bate Felix, Aidan Lewis

*   Summary
*   Companies

*   US sitting on approval for $14 billion arms package for Taiwan
*   Trump, Xi to meet in Washington next week
*   Drone maker Anduril sells weapons to Taiwan
*   China sanctioned Anduril's founder last year

TAIPEI, Sept 19 (Reuters) - US defence tech firm Anduril's founder Palmer Luckey said on ​Saturday that President Donald Trump's delay in approving arms sales to Taiwan is affecting its business and ‌that he has discussed this with Trump.

The $14 billion package for Taiwan has been awaiting Trump's approval for months. After a May summit in Beijing with Chinese President Xi Jinping, Trump said he was holding it in abeyance and described it as a "very good negotiating chip".

Make sense of global markets with the Trading Day newsletter. Sign up [here.](https://www.reuters.com/newsletters/trading-day/?location=article-paragraph&redirectUrl=%2Fworld%2Fchina%2Fdefence-firm-anduril-says-us-delay-taiwan-arms-sales-affecting-its-business-2026-09-19%2F)

China claims democratically governed Taiwan ​as its own, an assertion Taipei rejects. The issue of Taiwan is likely to be high on Xi's agenda ​when he meets Trump in Washington next week.

Speaking to reporters in Taipei where he attended a ⁠defence forum with Taiwan President Lai Ching-te, Luckey said he did not know the status of the arms package.

"It's definitely affecting ​the business in that our business with Taiwan would be in a different place if you had that $14 billion moving forward," ​he said, declining to give details about what was being delayed for the company.

## DRONES RESHAPE WARFARE

Anduril, whose Altius drone is used by Taiwan, has become one of Silicon Valley's hottest defence bets as drones reshape warfare in Ukraine and the Middle East and Trump pushes the Pentagon to adopt ​cutting-edge technologies to counter China.

Luckey, whom [China sanctioned](https://www.reuters.com/business/aerospace-defense/china-sanctions-us-defence-firms-individuals-over-arms-sales-taiwan-2025-12-26/) in December for selling weapons to Taiwan, said one of the problems in delaying ​the package was that it had a broader, longer-lasting impact. "It's that as long as that's stuck, you don't have continued forward progress in ‌other areas," ⁠he said.

The White House did not immediately respond to a request for comment outside office hours.

China has repeatedly told the US to stop selling weapons to Taiwan and has sanctioned numerous US companies that sell arms to the island. The US is bound by law to provide Taiwan with the means to defend itself, though Trump has called that commitment into question.

Luckey said he had ​discussed the issue of Taiwan arms ​sales with Trump, Vice ⁠President JD Vance and Secretary of State Marco Rubio. He said the administration was open to hearing from people on the issue but aware of the fallout that could come from selling ​more weapons to Taiwan, such as China using its leverage with rare earths crucial for tech ​companies.

"And so I've ⁠heard people say, shouldn't he just approve the deal and damn the consequences? But he's getting briefed by other people who are not me, and they're saying, 'If you do this, here's what's going to happen to American consumers'," Luckey said.

"He has to weigh all ⁠of those ​things. He's in a really difficult, difficult situation," Luckey added, referring to Trump.

Lai, ​who shook hands with Luckey at the forum's start, has made drones a central part of Taiwan's military modernisation.

Last year, Taiwan unveiled its first missile to ​be jointly made with a US company, Anduril's [Barracuda-500,](https://www.reuters.com/business/aerospace-defense/taiwan-shows-off-first-missile-be-jointly-manufactured-with-us-arms-maker-2025-09-17/) an autonomous, low-cost cruise missile.

Reporting by Ben Blanchard in Taipei; Editing by William Mallard

Our Standards: [The Thomson Reuters Trust Principles., opens new tab](https://www.thomsonreuters.com/en/about-us/trust-principles.html)

Ben joined Reuters as a company news reporter in Shanghai in 2003 before moving to Beijing in 2005 to cover Chinese politics and diplomacy. In 2019 Ben was appointed the Taiwan bureau chief covering everything from elections and entertainment to semiconductors.

title: Vietnam attends Mekong-Lancang forum on combating fake news in Cambodia
summary: Friday, 13:12, 18/09/2026 ## Vietnam attended a media forum and award ceremony for a 2026 anti-fake news contest in Phnom Penh, Cambodia, on September 17, highlighting the importance of information integrity in the Mekong-Lancang region. Pa
content:
Friday, 13:12, 18/09/2026

## Vietnam attended a media forum and award ceremony for a 2026 anti-fake news contest in Phnom Penh, Cambodia, on September 17, highlighting the importance of information integrity in the Mekong-Lancang region.

Participants at the opening ceremony of the forum

The forum, themed "Combating Fake News and Promoting Information Integrity in the Mekong-Lancang Region," brought together Cambodian Minister of Information Neth Pheaktra, Vietnamese Ambassador to Cambodia Nguyen Minh Vu, representatives of the embassies of China and ASEAN countries in Cambodia, and delegations from Mekong-Lancang Cooperation (MLC) member countries. The event also attracted media experts, reporters, journalists, and content creators. Organised by the Cambodian Ministry of Information in coordination with the Mekong-Lancang Cooperation Special Fund, the forum aimed to raise public awareness of the risks and consequences of fake news and irresponsible information sharing. It also provided a platform for participants to exchange experience in fact-checking and strengthen regional cooperation to curb the spread of misinformation.

Speaking at the event, Kan Pharidh, Secretary of State at the Cambodian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation and Chairman of the Cambodia’s National Secretariat for Mekong-Lancang Cooperation, noted that digital transformation and advances in artificial intelligence have created major opportunities while also increasing the risks posed by misinformation, disinformation, and deliberately distorted content.

If left unaddressed, these challenges could undermine public trust, damage the credibility of institutions, weaken social cohesion, and negatively affect peace, stability, and cooperation in the region, he said.

Kan Pharidh called for stronger joint efforts within the MLC framework to address the negative impacts of misleading information on regional development. He also stressed the importance of providing timely, reliable, and accurate information, highlighting the role of professional and responsible journalism in building public trust and promoting mutual understanding.

For his part, Minister Neth Pheaktra shared that combating fake news should go beyond correcting false information after it has spread. He called for the development of an information ecosystem that ensures access to reliable information, maintains high professional media standards, promotes effective public communication, and encourages responsible technology use and digital literacy.

He highlighted Cambodia’s ongoing efforts through the “No Fake News” campaign and initiatives promoting media and digital literacy, professional journalism, responsible content creation, and timely public communication.

Following discussions and experience-sharing sessions, the organisers presented the "Zero Fake News Media and Content Creator Awards" to five journalistic works that had made positive contributions to society.

title: China presses Iran to help rein in Houthis after Saudi appeal, sources say
summary: * Summary * China asks Iran to help curb Houthis, three sources say * Riyadh sought China's help as Houthi threat grew, they say * Sources say it is unclear how Tehran will respond * Red Sea escalation threatens energy routes vital to China
content:
*   Summary

*   China asks Iran to help curb Houthis, three sources say
*   Riyadh sought China's help as Houthi threat grew, they say
*   Sources say it is unclear how Tehran will respond
*   Red Sea escalation threatens energy routes vital to China

DUBAI, Sept 17 (Reuters) - China has privately asked Tehran to help rein in [Yemen's Houthis](https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/trump-hopes-iran-war-nearing-end-houthi-saudi-fighting-escalates-2026-09-17/) after an appeal to Beijing by Saudi Arabia following the Iran-backed group's military blitz in the past week, according to three Iranian sources familiar with ​the matter.

Riyadh turned to China for help after the Houthis made rapid advances along the Red Sea coast and around the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, moves that have left [Saudi oil exports](https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/polands-orlen-rushes-find-alternatives-saudi-oil-supply-traders-say-2026-09-15/) and ‌shipping more exposed, the sources said.

Make sense of global markets with the Trading Day newsletter. Sign up [here.](https://www.reuters.com/newsletters/trading-day/?location=article-paragraph&redirectUrl=%2Fworld%2Fchina%2Fchina-presses-iran-help-rein-houthis-after-saudi-appeal-sources-say-2026-09-17%2F)

China has publicly [called for restraint](https://www.reuters.com/world/china/chinas-top-diplomat-urges-iran-us-show-restraint-revive-talks-2026-09-16/), dialogue and the restoration of safe navigation, but its private message went further than the public statements, they said.

Beijing wants Iran to use its influence with [the Houthis](https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/how-yemens-houthis-went-small-mountain-militia-big-regional-threat-2026-09-17/) to help prevent the conflict spreading further across energy routes on which China, the world's second-largest economy, depends.

The sources, who were briefed on the discussions and spoke on condition of anonymity, did not provide details of how the message was delivered or whether it was conveyed during a visit to China ​on Wednesday by Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi.

The sources said Tehran's response was that stability and peace in the region depend on ending the [US-Israeli war on Iran](https://www.reuters.com/world/iran/).

Chinese officials did not issue any explicit threats ​or indicate that Beijing would seek to pressure Tehran economically if it failed to use its influence over the Houthis, the three Iranian sources said.

In response to a ⁠Reuters request for comment on this story, the Chinese foreign ministry said: "China does not wish to see regional tensions further spill over into Yemen and the Red Sea. Escalating regional instability is not in the interests of ​any party".

"The sovereignty and security of all countries should be respected, and facilities vital to people's livelihoods must not be targeted. China calls for an end to actions that further complicate the situation and urges resolving issues through dialogue ​and negotiation," it said.

Iran's foreign ministry and the Saudi government's media office did not immediately respond to Reuters requests for comment for this article.

## DANGERS OF A WIDER REGIONAL WAR

China has been Iran's largest trading partner for more than a decade and remains the main buyer of its oil. Chinese purchases accounted for more than 80% of Iran's seaborne oil exports in 2025, averaging about 1.4 million barrels per day, according to commodities data and analytics firm Kpler.

"Beijing is one of the few capitals that can still ​press Iran to rein in the Houthis," said a senior Western diplomat in the region.

The Houthis, who emerged in the 1990s in opposition to Saudi Arabia's Sunni religious influence in Yemen, are armed, trained and funded by Iran, ​according to Iranian sources and Western countries, and form part of Tehran's anti-Western, anti-Israel "Axis of Resistance".

Item 1 of 3 Iran-aligned Houthi fighters pose next to a captured vehicle following what the source described as an attack on Saudi-backed forces in the location given by the source as al Jawf governorate, Yemen, in this screengrab taken from a video released by Houthi Military Media on September 15, 2026. HOUTHI MILITARY MEDIA/Handout via REUTERS

**[1/3]**Iran-aligned Houthi fighters pose next to a captured vehicle following what the source described as an attack on Saudi-backed forces in the location given by the source as al Jawf governorate, Yemen, in this screengrab taken from a video released by Houthi Military Media on September 15, 2026.... [Purchase Licensing Rights, opens new tab](https://www.reutersconnect.com/item/battle-between-iran-aligned-houthi-fighters-and-saudi-backed-forces-in-al-jawf-governate/dGFnOnJldXRlcnMuY29tLDIwMjY6bmV3c21sX1JDMlVKTkFDUUUwRg%3D%3D/?utm_medium=rcom-article-media&utm_campaign=rcom-rcp-lead)Read more

Any threat by the Houthis to shipping in the Red Sea and through the Bab el-Mandeb Strait risks sharply worsening the [global energy crisis](https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/oil-prices-extend-losses-fears-middle-east-supply-disruptions-ease-2026-09-17/) since Iran started ‌blocking the Strait ⁠of Hormuz and increasing the danger of a wider regional conflict.

With Hormuz already effectively shut, sustained Houthi attacks on vessels or ports in the Red Sea would disrupt the Middle East's two main oil-export routes simultaneously, opening a new front in both the energy crisis and Iran's broader confrontation with the United States.

Iran and its allies now exert pressure over both ends of the region's key maritime network, one of the sources said, adding that "China depends on both".

Alex Vatanka, director of the Iran Program at the Middle East Institute in Washington, said Beijing may oppose US pressure on Tehran, but its interests in the Middle East extend well beyond Iran. Roughly half of China's oil ​imports come from the region, while trade between China and ​the Gulf Cooperation Council states totals around $300 billion ⁠a year.

"Iran can disrupt Hormuz. But at some point that leverage begins hurting the very power Tehran increasingly depends on," Vatanka said.

## CHINA'S DILEMMA

It is unclear whether Tehran will act on the concerns raised by Beijing, according to the three Iranian sources.

The relationship nevertheless carries significant economic and strategic weight for Iran as it continues to face hostilities ​with the US, they said.

China is among the few countries with the financial capacity to provide the investment Tehran needs to sustain its oil industry and ​ease pressure on its [economy](https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/war-weighs-irans-economy-us-intensifies-sanctions-2026-08-29/), battered by ⁠war and sanctions.

Beijing has also demonstrated its diplomatic influence. In 2023, China brokered the agreement that restored ties between Iran and Saudi Arabia after years of hostility.

That influence has limits, however. Critics inside Iran have complained about the relatively modest level of Chinese non-oil trade and investment since the two countries signed a 25-year cooperation pact in 2021, particularly compared with China's growing investment commitments in Gulf Arab states.

China remains a factor Tehran cannot afford to ignore, but two of the ⁠Iranian sources said ​Beijing's interests were only one consideration among many. Iran's decisions are shaped by competing strategic, economic and political priorities, they said.

"Tehran and ​Beijing need each other. China is a factor Tehran cannot ignore, and Beijing wants Hormuz reopened and Red Sea shipping secured," the Western diplomat said.

Analysts say the key test will be whether China is prepared to attach consequences to its demands. Ultimately, they say, the clearest sign ​of Beijing's resolve would be evidence that it is willing to use its leverage over Tehran.

Additional reporting by Liz Lee in Beijing and Timour Azhari in Riyadh, Writing by Parisa Hafezi, Editing by Angus McDowall and Timothy Heritage

content:
2026年9月24日，英国著名通灵预言家汉密尔顿-帕克，在他的直播中，说到一段奇遇。两位未经预约的神秘西藏喇嘛，悄然闯入帕克的家门，突然出现在他家的前厅，带来的藏地密卷、神秘的古老预言、中共国即将发动新的一场病毒生化战争，以及直接关乎到当今中共高层的极度机密、[习近平](https://www.secretchina.com/news/gb/tag/%E4%B9%A0%E8%BF%91%E5%B9%B3)的个人健康危机，和关乎台海地缘政治战争。

这不是他在冥想中看到的幻象，而是在现实物理世界中，真真切切发生在他客厅里的谈话内容。大家好，我是自媒体“Edward文鸣”，今天我们一起来看帕克的这场奇遇。

**中共曾试图释放一场新[瘟疫](https://www.secretchina.com/news/gb/tag/%E7%98%9F%E7%96%AB)**

故事发生在几天前。帕克当时在家里正在调整自己，进入灵性状态，准备解读纳迪叶预言的时候，他的家里来了不速之客。帕克说当时，他正在屋子里摆弄相机和设备，一位助理在帮我干活。助理突然对他说：“帕克，刚才有人走进来了。”帕克走进前厅，发现两位西藏僧侣站在那里……

[![Image 1](https://img6.secretchina.com/pic/2024/11-2/p3556881a508884777.jpg)](https://naturexcels.com/language/zh/)

两位西藏僧侣，没有事前预约、联络，就这样悄无声息地穿过大门，出现在了一个英国通灵师的客厅里。帕克形容说，这两人并没有穿着全套传统的藏传佛教僧袍，而是穿着相当得体、干精。其中一位非常健谈，另一位则保持沉默。

那位健谈的僧侣向帕克展示了他与达赖喇嘛的合影，证明了自己的身份，他甚至是一位受过高度训练的心脏外科医生。他们跨越千山万水，飞到英国，只为找到帕克。为什么要亲自跑一趟，而不是发邮件或打电话？僧侣对帕克说他们来到我这里，是想与帕克分享他们的一些秘密，而这些秘密是中国政府绝对机密。所以他们想把信息用一种迂回的方式传达出去。因为中共的跨国渗透很厉害，在中共严密的数字极权和跨国镇压网络下，藏人的一举一动都在国安部和统战部的严密监视中。

僧人向帕克展示了一些西藏古老的图卷和记录，西藏也有着与印度“纳迪叶”极为相似的古老预言木简（与印度柔软的棕榈叶不同，他们是用木板条，并用绳子串起来）。这些西藏密卷中，不仅记载了古老的医学，还记载了对未来的精确预言。

接下来僧侣透露的第一个机密，是另一场大流行病即将到来。这将是一种会影响肺部的疾病，是一种类似**生物武器**的疾病，将会非常难以控制。僧侣说，（中共）不久前曾试图释放这个[病毒](https://www.secretchina.com/news/gb/tag/%E7%97%85%E6%AF%92)，但后来中国人退缩了。帕克说，如果我们没理解错的话，这表明，有某种东西原本是要作为战争武器被释放出来的。

帕克相信这绝对不是空穴来风。从武汉病毒研究所的泄漏疑云开始，国际社会，包括美国情报界，一直怀疑中共军方在进行功能获得性的生物武器研究。中共解放军内部早就有《非典非自然起源和人制新种病毒基因武器》这样的军事著作出版，明确提出了生物战的新概念。这本书2015年8月由解放军空军军医大学（原第四军医大学）流行病学教授徐德忠等人撰写，这本书的初衷是阐述2003年爆发的非典（SARS）冠状病毒并非源自大自然的基因进化，而是“美军制造并对中国施放的基因武器”的阴谋论假说。但在新冠疫情爆发后，西方媒体和调查人员发现书中详细探讨了将冠状病毒作为“人制新种病毒基因武器”的施放方式和生物战概念，这说明“中国早在2015年就知道，且在密谋研发冠状病毒生物武器”，否则为何机理说得如此准确详细？

僧侣透露中共“不久前曾试图释放，但后来退缩了”。这意味着什么？这意味着在中共高层的某个绝密会议上，曾提议使用这种超级生物武器来解决当前的地缘政治危机（比如为武统台湾做准备，或是摧毁西方经济），但因为某种原因——可能是内部权斗、忌惮遭到西方核报复，或是病毒本身出现了不可控的变异——习近平在最后关头按下了暂停键。

但危机并没有解除，新的病毒释放可能会在意想不到的某个节点还会到来。

说出这个秘密之后，僧侣们带来了一丝希望，这个希望同样隐藏在中共的体制阴暗中。僧侣告诉帕克，在西藏的古老医学文献中，其实记载着治疗这些可怕疾病的解药。僧侣说，中国制造出来的第一款新冠[疫苗](https://www.secretchina.com/news/gb/tag/%E7%96%AB%E8%8B%97)，实际上是一位西藏医生研发的。但这位西藏医生不得不把自己的名字改成汉族名字，他必须假装是汉人，但他就是藏人，而且他查阅了古老的预言神谕来帮助他找到解药。

中共一直在对少数民族进行残酷同化和对知识产权无耻掠夺。中共高层极度迷信中医和神秘疗法，他们不仅在新疆、西藏进行惨无人道的器官活摘，为高层特权阶级的“健康工程”（如传闻中的981首长健康工程）提供供体，更在暗中搜刮西藏古老的医学典籍。

在西藏密卷中，已经有了应对下一场超级生物武器的解药。这两位僧侣冒死将这个信息传递给帕克，是希望西方世界，甚至AI技术能够提前介入，破解这个解药的方程式，以对抗中共未来可能发动的超限战。

**幽浮（****UFO****）、太空争霸与中共高层的神秘学狂热**

如果说生化武器还在常规军事讨论范围内，那么两位僧侣接下来向帕克展示的内容，就直接进入了大烧脑洞的领域了。

僧侣告诉帕克：中共特工及研究人员还在西藏搜寻到其他古老密卷，而其中一部分，完全是关于UFO（不明飞行物）和太空旅行的！

僧侣告诉帕克，如果你注意到，当中国的太空人从月球着陆器出来，从外层空间返回时，他们的身体状态非常非常好。因为据说在这些文献中，有特殊的配方和药物，能够帮助人在外层空间生存，这是一种完全不同的藏医学系统，能帮助去过外层空间并返回的人非常迅速地适应环境。

这个爆料听起来匪夷所思，但结合历史秘闻，却有一种“细思极恐”的合理性。西藏是个特殊的地方，连他们的修炼方法据高人说都是外星球传来的。还流传说，珠穆朗玛峰隐藏着外星生命通往地心世界的入口，并被很多有功能的生命守候着。

帕克说：“当你回顾历史，你是否意识到，纳粹曾经进入西藏？他们在寻找神秘学的秘密，甚至在寻找约柜。约柜是古代以色列民族的圣物，根据《圣经》记载，它是由先知摩西按照上帝的指示建造的，用来盛放刻有“十诫”的两块石碑，和其他圣物。差不多有一块大方砖那么大，里外包裹纯金。据《马加比传下》记载，先知耶利米收到神谕，在耶路撒冷沦陷前将约柜等藏在了尼波山（MountNebo）的一个洞穴中，并封死了入口。

由于约柜神秘的传说和巨大的力量，它也成为了流行文化和好莱坞电影的灵感源泉，其中最著名的便是斯皮尔伯格执导、哈里森·福特主演的经典冒险电影《夺宝奇兵》。电影里的很多东西在现实世界中是真实发生过的，纳粹的希特勒等人对古代那些拥有巨大力量的物品极度狂热。”

无神论的共产党，其实是世界上最迷信的利益集团。这在体制内外是公开的秘密。[毛泽东](https://www.secretchina.com/news/gb/tag/%E6%AF%9B%E6%B3%BD%E4%B8%9C)当年的中央警卫局为什么叫“8341”部队？传闻就是老道士算准了毛的寿命是83岁，掌权41年；江泽民晚年疯狂抄写《地藏经》，逢庙必拜，还在九华山求神拜佛以求延寿；而习近平对风水的痴迷更是达到了登峰造极的地步，为了保住所谓的“龙脉”，他不惜大动干戈，发动了著名的“陕西秦岭别墅案”，将一大批地方高官投入大牢，就因为他们在龙脉上违章建筑，破坏了习的风水。

如今，中共在航天领域、登月计划上的发展，背后是否真的借助了西藏古老文明遗留下来的高级知识？那些被严密封锁的藏传佛教地下书库，是否已经被中共军方的科学院洗劫一空？两位僧侣的爆料，为中共的太空霸权蒙上了一层极度神秘的色彩。

**转世大战、达赖喇嘛“****130****岁”阳谋**

除了寻找太空药物，中共在西藏还有一个最核心的政治任务：控制下一任达赖喇嘛的转世。僧侣：“西藏的古老预言正在向他们展示去哪里寻找未来的达赖喇嘛。灵魂的显现涉及到四个不同的存在。也就是说，尽管现任达赖喇嘛依然在世，但已经在为下一次转世做准备了，并且未来的灵魂已经盘旋在四个不同的源头之上，最终将从这四个中选出一个。”或许也暗示了达赖喇嘛即将发生某种变化。说到达赖，人们自然会想到另一个名字：班禅喇嘛。“真正的班禅喇嘛在还是一个小男孩的时候，就被中国人绑架并失踪了。中共绑架了真正的第十一世班禅喇嘛（更登确吉尼玛），并强行安排了一个假的班禅（确吉杰布）。

中共的宗教局曾经颁布过一个《藏传佛教活佛转世管理办法》（俗称第五号令），明文规定活佛转世必须经过共产党的批准。一个标榜无神论的马列主义政党，竟然要指导神佛如何转世，这简直是人类历史上最大的黑色幽默。

僧侣说，现任的第十四世达赖喇嘛很清楚这一点。他一直声称自己要活到130岁，或者宣布自己可能不再转世，或者将转世为女性，用这种幽默方式，来嘲讽、化解中共当局邪恶图谋，想彻底打乱中共操控“转世计划”。但同时，这也预示着，围绕西藏精神领袖的暗战，即将在未来几年达到白热化。

如果说前面的爆料是前奏，那么接下来关于习近平本人的信息则是两位藏地高僧向帕克传递的重磅。

帕克感觉当习近平处于一个非常脆弱的境地时，会发生一场针对他的**政变**。帕克说，这就像食人鱼一样，只要有一滴血，它们就会全部蜂拥而上。习的脆弱可能是一个触发点，目前中国有一股力量正准备试图夺取政权。”

为什么说是“食人鱼”？大家看看习近平这两年在军队内部掀起的腥风血雨就知道了。而在这些政变大清洗的背后，隐藏着习近平极度恐惧。这也就是为什么他现在出行安保达到了神经质的地步，连喝水的杯子都必须是专人保管的专用茶杯，绝不碰外面的任何食物。

习近平的健康问题，一直是中共最高级别的国家机密。但近年来，无论是他出访法国时被拍到步履蹒跚、走路明显瘸腿，还是在南非金砖峰会上诡异地缺席晚宴，亦或是在国内重要会议期间频频传出中风、胰腺癌或者脑动脉瘤的谣言，都说明了一点：那滴“血”，已经漏出来了。在中共这种黑箱政治体制下，最高领导人的健康就是政权的晴雨表。毛泽东晚年流着口水接见外宾时，江青和四人帮就已经开始和华国锋、叶剑英疯狂暗斗；如今的习近平，也面临着同样的窘境。

帕克说，他感觉他（习近平）比他表现出来的要病得重得多。而背后发生了很多事情。美国中情局（CIA）和其他机构很可能知道正在发生什么。他们知道习近平此刻可能处于相当虚弱的位置。”帕克说：“我有一种感觉，我们很快就会看到一场针对习近平的潜在行动，因此，这可能引发一场针对任何反对他的人的大清洗。”

在习川会期间，平台上传出韩正落马消息，因为韩正在曾庆红的布局之下，是典型的权力过渡人物，企图先由韩正取代大病缠身的习近平，然后交给丁薛祥。中南海的红墙之内，已经是一片血雨腥风，食人鱼们正在等待习近平彻底倒下的那一刻。

**2028****时间窗、台海战争与中国解体**

如果习近平感到自己权力即将不保，或者健康状况无法支撑他继续大权独揽，他会怎么做？这就来到了两位僧侣与帕克探讨的最危险的话题——战争与解体。

帕克一直预言中国最终会爆发革命并解体。他在视频中向两位僧侣求证，僧侣回答说：“是的，中国会分裂成多个国家、多个联邦或州……在西藏的预言中就是这么说的，中国将分裂成许多国家，这将是一件好事。西藏将保持统一，但西藏的东部将会有一场崛起。”

为什么是从东部崛起？西藏的东部，正是四川、青海一带，那是传统的康区和安多地区，那里有着最彪悍的藏族部落，也是中共军队维稳压力极大的火药桶。一旦中共中央政权衰弱，边疆的裂变将首先从这些地方引爆。

那么，是什么事件会触发中共的最终崩溃和解体呢？帕克说：“触发点将会是台湾。因为当习正在失去权力时，他该怎么做？没有什么比发动一场战争更好的了！你知道，战争能团结所有人，能迅速把所有人为一个共同的事业拉到一起。”英国前首相撒契尔夫人就是如此。当年撒契尔夫人在国内面临极大政治压力时，果断出兵福克兰群岛（马岛战争），打败阿根廷后，她披着胜利的荣光，获得了前所未有的政治权力。

习近平现在面临的，是比当年撒契尔夫人险恶百倍的绝境。国内经济已经实质性崩溃，房地产爆雷，地方债务堆积如山，年轻人失业率高到统计局不敢发布数据。体制内的降薪潮已经蔓延到了长三角和珠三角的核心公务员阶层。民怨沸腾，如同地下奔涌的岩浆。

在这种“内卷到极致便会外爆”的历史规律下，武统台湾，就成了习近平转移国内矛盾、实施全面军管、清洗政治异己的唯一、也是最后的一根救命稻草。

然而，帕克和僧侣们的预言给出了另一种结局：这场战争不会带来中共的复兴，而是会成为压垮共产帝国的最后一根稻草。战争一旦陷入僵局，或者遭遇西方严厉的经济与能源封锁，中共内部的“食人鱼”就会借机发动政变，庞大的红色帝国将会像苏联一样，在一夕之间分崩离析，分裂成多个自治共和国或联邦。

content:
北京女子孙美华被拐26年，被摧残得面目皆非。（图片来源：网络图片）

【看中国2026年9月29日讯】短暂的越洋通话后，孙美华再度被推入“信息黑洞”。作为维权人士的姐夫，同在[北京](https://www.secretchina.com/news/gb/tag/%E5%8C%97%E4%BA%AC)却被切断联络和探视妹妹的机会，大洋彼岸的姐姐也不例外；全网视频文章悉数下架，审查力度远超以往“丰县铁链女”“和顺精障女硕士”事件。失踪二十六年的孙美华再次消失在公众视野中。

2026年9月初，一段不到六分钟的微信视频通话，在太平洋两端仓促接通。

屏幕那一头是在山东省菏泽市曹县被寻获的妹妹[孙美华](https://www.secretchina.com/news/gb/tag/%E5%AD%99%E7%BE%8E%E5%8D%8E)。她端着一碗馄饨，眼神躲闪、惊惶，身体下意识地紧绷。远在美国的二姐孙翠华盯着屏幕，没敢哭出声，连话也不敢大声说，只是反复叮嘱：“小心一点，吃吧，吃吧……”

[![Image 2](https://img6.secretchina.com/pic/2025/7-29/p3676411a560438137.jpg)](https://www.naturenergy.us/)

她问妹妹：“美华，我是姐姐，你知道吗？”对面的女人神情木讷，没有应答。孙翠华的心直往下沉。

一旁的儿子凑到屏幕前，试探着叫了一声：“小姨，你认得我吗？”

那个面容枯槁、神情僵硬的女人顿住了，随即轻轻点了点头，呼唤起他的乳名。漫长的二十六年风霜与精神世界的坍塌，没有抹去她极其疼爱孩子的本能。

挂断视频后，孙翠华感到手和嘴唇一阵阵发麻。这一生中，她只经历过两次这样的身体僵直与剧烈眩晕：一次是2000年左右，患有精神分裂的妹妹被妹夫遗失在路口，全家人骑着车、印着几百张寻人启事跑遍全北京；另一次，就是时隔二十六年，在屏幕里看见妹妹“已经不成样子”的这一刻。

## **爱时髦的北京女孩**

在[网络](https://www.secretchina.com/news/gb/tag/%E7%BD%91%E7%BB%9C)寻人热潮中，孙美华的名字被层层叠叠的传闻所覆盖：会说一口流利英语和外贸术语、精通芭蕾舞与交谊舞、出入友谊宾馆，出身高知高干家庭……

然而，在姐姐孙翠华与姐夫刘安军的记忆里，这些大多是网络误读拼凑出的幻影。她只是家里的“三儿”，一个生于1968年属猴、在北京二环土生土长的胡同姑娘。

“小时候大家条件都不好，不吃窝头就是好事了。”孙翠华回忆。父母原是机械厂工人，父亲早年还在友谊宾馆掌过勺做厨师——这段经历可能令“友谊宾馆”成了美华的记忆残片。

在胡同那间十四五平方米的防震棚里，孙美华度过了少女时代。那是唐山大地震后挨着亲大爷家搭起来的偏厢房，里间搁着一张床，外间就是烟火缭绕的窄小厨房。跟着奶奶长大的二姐，中学后才搬回来，相差6岁的姐妹俩便挤在这间简陋棚子里，同睡一张床。

据姐夫描述，孙母颇为“重男轻女”，二姐则得到父亲的偏爱，而老三美华是“意外怀孕”，父母原本并不想要。在他眼中，美华在家里的地位“好像跟多余的似的”。家里有好吃的，总是哥哥、姐姐先吃，美华从不争抢；洗衣服、打水做杂活，她从五六岁没上学时起就默默承担。

和姐姐性子急、嗓门大不同，美华内向少言，不爱扎堆、交际，见谁都微笑，只有在熟人面前高兴起来才会蹦跶。单眼皮、大眼睛的她，面容清秀，但幼时意外磕碰，左眼下方留下一道三指宽的显眼疤痕，加上瘦小如竹竿，一度被家里人半开玩笑地唤作“丑三儿”。

初中毕业那年，她原本在136中念书，成绩还可以。当时家里征求她的意见：是接着读高中，还是去工作？美华选择了上班，一心想着能早点挣钱自立。她进了崇文区粮食局系统的旅馆，最初做客房服务员，因为做事利索，一年多后升到了前台负责收银和住宿登记。

80年代中期，改革开放潮头涌动。自己挣了工资，美华开始有了爱美的心思，喜欢赶时髦、买漂亮衣服，淡妆遮住疤痕，更使她光彩照人。二姐和姐夫去了河北北戴河开小饭馆，她也曾去探望，带着不到两岁的小外甥，流连在繁华的服装市场，买回几件最时兴的牛仔裤、牛仔裙和牛仔上衣。

在家里，美华最亲近的是小孩子，哪怕自己兜里只有几毛零钱，她也总舍得掏出一大半，牵着孩子的手去买冰棍、买糖吃。结婚前只要一休假，她就跑到二姐家里待着，围着外甥转。她的随身包里也总藏着糖果，把家里的几个孩子聚在一起认字：“今天谁学会这个字，明天就有糖吃。”小外甥常常能认出字来，抓着糖满屋跑；别的孩子认不出，急得抢糖，在一块儿打闹，有时下手没轻没重，甚至把这个当小姨的逗得又笑又哭。那是孙美华人生里最明媚、轻快的一段时光。

## **阴影或许是从旅馆工作后期开始笼罩下来的。**

在姐夫刘安军的印象中，美华可能在旅馆遭到了某领导的性骚扰，但因涉事人员与家中兄长相熟，事情最终未能公开处理，反而成了家庭内部的禁忌。孙宝华知道这个说法，却斥之为谬谈，“他怎么会骚扰我妹妹呢，真可笑。”

孙翠华隐约记得，美华确实在单位遇到了“不愉快的事”，此后变得不爱说话。她曾私下问过妹妹到底发生了什么，美华很抵触：“你甭管了，你瞎掺和这事干嘛。”

看到美华不开口也不搭理人，孙翠华觉得不对劲，催促母亲带妹妹去医院看看。父母带着美华去了宣武医院，医生曾拿着压舌板一样的木棍刮按她的脚心做神经反射检查。从宣武医院到后来的安定医院，美华断断续续看了一年多，遵医嘱按时服药，病情控制得相当稳定。当时的具体诊断，究竟是抑郁症还是精神分裂，孙翠华说家人瞒着她，自己也不清楚；而姐夫刘安军则十分肯定地说，美华在婚前还只是抑郁状态，并没有其他异常。

然而，家庭关系的暗流逐渐将美华推向边缘。由于嫂子的排挤，加上精神方面的隐忧，美华开始被家人催促着“出嫁”。

在父亲的张罗下，大约在1992年，24岁的美华与三元牛奶职工方某某结了婚。这桩婚事美华起初并不情愿，她曾对姐姐袒露过择偶的标准，“想找个聪明点、能把家撑起来的，长相无所谓”。但她最终选择了妥协。毕竟从小到大她都是家里最会“忍让”的那个。

婚礼前一天，因为家庭内部的积怨，母亲提前打电话，甚至没有让姐姐孙翠华一家前往现场观礼。这场缺席的婚礼，成了姐妹俩心头长久的一块伤疤。

至今在网上流传的那张泛黄照片，具体是何时在何种场景下拍摄的已不可考。那是美华结婚的同一年，她留着一头时髦的卷发，身穿一袭粉色的套装长裙。姐夫认得出，相片背景似乎是家里的窗帘，永远留下了她抿嘴微笑的青春模样。

## **消失在十字路口的母亲**

婚后的生活并没有给美华带来安宁。

婚后一年，美华生下了一个女儿。1996年左右，她因精神分裂办理了病退和残疾证。病情稳定时，她曾推着三轮车，帮着丈夫在城墙边卖过散装牛奶。但在夫家，随着病情反复，她与婆婆、大姑姐之间的冲突逐渐频繁，甚至遭到推搡与殴打。

孙翠华说，妹妹状态好时，会亲昵地抱她，不断唤她“姐姐姐姐”，只有被招惹到时才会骂人。她曾为了妹妹上门与婆家理论：“她是个病人，她犯病骂人，你不搭理她不就完了？干嘛非要跟一个病人斤斤计较？”

那次争吵后，两家彻底断了往来。美华在夫家待不下去，失踪前两年，每个月她总有一两次被送回娘家小住半月或一个月。姐夫说，病情严重时，她偶尔不认人，但这样的情况很少。她日常生活完全能够自理，能独自坐一小时公交跨区往返，社会功能并未丧失。

在饱受精神困扰的日子里，美华对女儿仍抱着本能的关怀。孙翠华偶尔拎着水果点心去看她，在那间阴暗逼仄、终日见不到多少光亮的小平房里，美华接过吃的，自己舍不得吃，小心翼翼地收起大半，留给自己的女儿。孙翠华心疼地劝她：“你自己留着吃吧，孩子她奶奶她爸少不了给她买。”美华却执拗地护着那点吃的。“她不傻，她要真傻了，能知道把好东西全留给闺女吗？”孙翠华说。

2000年的一天，方某某突然来到孙家老宅，称来“接美华回家”。娘家人顿时愣住了——美华根本没有回来。方某某这才吐露，早在整整一个星期之前，他就已经把美华送回来了；因为有事，他只把她放在了距离娘家还有一公里左右的广安胡同十字路口，便径自离开了。

这迟来了一周的告知，让孙家彻底陷入慌乱。孙翠华复印了几百张寻人启事，顺着电线杆挨条街张贴，联络各种线索提供者。姐夫刘安军骑着车从宣武、崇文一直转到密云等远郊。

刘安军从一开始便怀疑方某某刻意遗弃妻子。美华走失时，适逢方家拆迁补偿敲定、看完新房准备搬迁，此前孙家人并不同意美华跟着迁户。更让他愤怒的是，方家人似乎对美华走失毫无惊讶或愧疚之意，他曾上门与方某某理论，甚至一气之下打了他。如今他更懊悔自己当初没有赖在他家坚持闹下去，否则万一方某某确曾参与“拐卖”，也许那时受不了就把美华“接”回来了。

当时刘安军和孙翠华数次前往广安门派出所、广内派出所报案，怀疑方某某涉嫌遗弃，但当时警方登记后，仅以“缺乏直接证据”未予刑事立案，也未出具书面法律文书。

寻人持续了大半年，毫无音讯。孙美华就像一滴水，落入了干涸的泥土。

“我妹妹是个认生的人。”孙翠华反复强调这一细节，“她从来不跟生人走，路人给的吃的她也绝不吃。如果不认识的人叫她，她只会躲得远远的。她一个人走在街上，怎么可能就这么没了？”

时间一年年推移，绝望在沉默中结痂。失踪大约四年后，夫家注销了孙美华在北京原籍的户口。

又过了三年多，2007年底，公安部刑事侦查局正式成立“打击拐卖妇女儿童犯罪办公室”（俗称“全国打拐办”），随后在2009年，公安部部署了全国打击拐卖儿童妇女专项行动并建立了全国打拐DNA数据库。留意到这些消息的刘安军，曾建议孙美华父母去登记失踪人口[信息](https://www.secretchina.com/news/gb/tag/%E4%BF%A1%E6%81%AF)和采血，孙父有意前往却遭到孙母反对。

2019年，孙翠华随儿子定居美国。在这个家庭里，“三儿”的失踪逐渐成为谁也不愿触碰的禁区。

2022年初，江苏徐州“铁链女”事件引发轰动。刘安军在海外社交网络上持续关注，但他没有对远在海外的妻子提起任何字眼，怕她“受不了”，“一看到铁链女，就感觉妹妹还不知道什么样。”他当时尖锐评论道，人口拐卖和器官交易屡禁不止，背后或存在公权力部门利益寻租。

2023年，孙美华的母亲与父亲相继在六月和十二月因病去世。当年春节，刘安军前往探视，第一次谈及“铁链女”，侧面重提寻找美华之事，但两位老人并未应允。“人家（小花梅被拐走时）没病，咱这有病。”孙母说。他猜测，老人家从心底里不相信有人会拐卖精神病人，这种事更不可能发生在北京，他们宁愿接受她已经不在人世，或者已“被好心人收留”。

母亲临终前，老胡同“腾退住户”收回的房产份额，最终被留给了长子孙宝华一家。至死，两位老人也未能等到小女儿的归期。母亲过世后，孙翠华曾梦到母亲一遍遍催促她：“回家，快回家看家。”孙翠华在梦里回绝：“我哥哥在看家呢，我不回去了。”

不可思议的感应出现在2026年的农历“中元节”（8月27日）前几天。她先是梦见了美华的女儿小时候的样子，哭着从梦中惊醒；第二天，她又梦见了已故的父亲，老人脚上的鞋子没了，正要把鞋子拿去变卖，她在梦里急得大哭：“你快穿上鞋，你是不是缺钱了？”

惊醒之后没过几天，消息毫无预兆地砸了过来。儿子在社交网络上刷到了热心寻人者“初心”发布的求助视频。视频拍摄于山东，一位蓬头垢面的老年流浪妇女，在纸上依稀写下了父亲孙登科、哥哥孙宝华的名字。他几乎一眼认出：“这是我小姨！”

9月4日，远在北京的哥哥孙宝华，也接到了北京西城警方通知，联系他们共同确认视频中人是不是妹妹。他们如梦初醒：失踪二十六年的孙美华，真的还活着。

## **“苦菜花”**

8月23日，孙美华穿着松垮的白色旧T恤，出现在寻亲志愿者杜小华的镜头里。她半倚在门框边，头发剪得很短，身形瘦削，面色黝黑，眉间的皱纹很深。眼神不回避镜头，却显得有些畏惧和迷茫。杜小华问她想不想回家，她似乎没有听懂，模糊地回答着“吃饭了”。这是互联网现存唯一公开发布的、关于美华的影像。她的左脸仍清晰可见一道细疤，正是幼时的印痕。

不久前，杜小华接到网友线索称，有一位大姐被骗来曹县当地近三十年，“开始时，村里或者十里八乡那种光棍可以跟这个大姐做那种事，带她来的这个老头在外面收钱”；后来，随着大姐年纪越来越大，没人再来性交易，她就和“老头”成了类似夫妻关系。

在杜小华得知美华的遭遇前，另一位寻亲志愿者“初心”已拍摄了近百条视频（已悉数删除）。彼时的美华还被称为“龙婶”，是“龙叔”的妻子。最初的见面是在村子的马路边，初心还不知道她的名字，只是听说这个穿着黑色碎花上衣、短发略显凌乱的女性，在这里站着饿了很久。她送给美华一袋炒面，反复问她叫什么名字，家在哪，有没有家人。美华的回答依旧模糊不清，听起来像是“苦菜花”。她就地蹲下，用手抓着吃起了面，马路边有车辆经过，扬起大片尘土。

那时候，美华的脸色更黑，像是被刻意抹上了炭灰，只有一双眼睛大而明亮。有网友猜测，将脸抹黑是她保护自己的一种方式。

龙叔家里还有另一位疑似轻度精神障碍的女性，被叫做“霞”，性格憨厚直爽，育有一女一儿，与龙叔的侄子“龙”是夫妻关系，几人共同生活在一个极其脏乱的小院里。初心的记录便由此开始，她帮助这家人收拾院子、改善关系，一起劳动和游玩，尤其是与霞缔结了深厚的姐妹情谊。霞会管初心叫“姐”，觉得那是对她最好的人，当初心告诉她，自己要回老家一段时间照顾孩子，霞会像小孩一样紧紧抱住初心，哭得撕心裂肺，不想她走，“我这几年过得不好”。

初心第一次遇到霞，也是在村子街头，那是在2022年7月，霞一头黑色长发，扎着略显凌乱的低马尾，牵着女儿翠翠和儿子国旗走在街头乞讨、拾荒。据初心此后视频的描述，那段时间的霞和孩子生活艰难，“吃白馒头、喝自来水、翻垃圾桶里捡来的废品、弯腰下跪靠好心人施舍。”

相比之下，在漫长、闭锁的农村院子里，美华总是沉默着，她没有能够以姐妹相称的人。破旧的农房里，空矿泉水瓶堆满了矮桌，被子、衣服凌乱地淤积在一起，那便是美华和龙叔共同生活的地方。

为数不多的记录里，美华是那个被支使着操持家务的人。一餐简陋的饭后，龙叔翘着二郎腿，坐在离锅不远的地方，一步步催促着美华，“拿丝瓜圈弄一圈锅”，沿着锅沿刷。美华穿着红蓝格相间的毛呢外套，表情有些呆滞，向龙叔嘟囔着什么，面露愠色，但手还是拿起了丝瓜圈，先是擦了锅铲，又在洗锅水里荡了一遍又一遍，动作轻而迟缓。

然而，随着相处日久，初心很快发现了美华的特别之处——她能写一手连笔字，会跳类似交谊舞的舞蹈动作，也能说出北京的地名。去年五一前夕，见龙叔生病住院，初心自称“不忍看到她孤独落魄的样子”，决定公开发布视频为她寻亲。当时美华已经在纸上准确写出自己和父亲的名字、以及“北京”两字，却并未取得寻亲进展。

一年时间过去，初心没有放弃，继续引导美华写出家人信息。这次，纸上又多了一行哥哥“孙宝华”的名字。今年5月左右，初心决定去找龙叔，要回美华的身份证。

最初龙叔把自己关在屋子里装睡，霞对着窗子反复催才肯出面。他说，证件（疑似）在一次就医中遗失，“你找年轻人去吧，我安排不下。”霞看不下去，觉得龙叔很“坏”，坚信身份证被藏在了屋子里，让龙叔“赶紧把她（美华）放了”。她凑近镜头，用气声说，（龙叔）只是怕初心把美华带走。

初心不甘，“看人家（美华）在你家过成啥样了，你叫人家走就完了。”初心说，“跟着你能享福吗？”龙叔断断续续回答，“是个伴”。

后来，初心以送一部二手手机作为交换，才终于从龙叔处获得了美华的身份证，只见身份证取名“张丽”，年龄则比美华实际年龄大3岁。她还采集了美华的血样，寄给浙江省嵊州市的[警察](https://www.secretchina.com/news/gb/tag/%E8%AD%A6%E5%AF%9F)商朝阳。商朝阳是公益寻亲团队“和合”工作室的负责人，可以帮助寻亲人士在全国打拐DNA信息库中做DNA采集比对。

然而，直到9月初，初心才发布一则视频：商朝阳电话通知她，确认美华是北京人，“可惜她爸妈已经不在了”。

## **未竟的安置与追责**

如果没有之后杜小华的出现和大范围的网络曝光，美华极有可能像霞那样，在寻亲成功后继续留在龙叔家中。

据独立媒体“自由娜拉”报道，8月23日，杜小华上门探访龙叔家，彼时他和美华一起在里屋，门上着锁，直到霞敲门称有人送东西，好几分钟后门才打开。面对杜小华的询问，龙叔自称今年78岁，不知道美华是哪里人，两人属于“晚婚”；他还声称从河南商丘梁园区把她接回来，迄今已有二十多年。

离开龙叔家后，杜小华便打了110，并在当晚发布抖音视频曝光。次日，曹县刑警大队人员向他说明了初步调查情况：孙美华1997年来到“龙叔”家（该年份早于家属所述），是龙叔“从河南商丘一个村子领过来的”，当时美华已有精神障碍；而警方向村支书、村民了解情况发现，龙叔没有虐待孙美华或强迫卖淫的行为；2020年，当地为孙美华上了户口。

对于曹县刑警大队的说法，杜小华怒而连发质疑：你们前任领导知道辖区内有这么个人吗？2020年为她上户口时，为何不采血、做人像识别？近年公安部多次部署打击拐卖专项行动，解救被长期控制的残障人士，今年采完血为什么她还留在“老头”家，你们难道不清楚他不具备容留美华大姐的资质吗？

对方表示，“这（安置）不是我们的事。”杜小华直言，“你不上报其他部门哪里知道，做不做是他们的事，报不报是你们的责任”，他当场表态，若官方不管，将联络寻子家长群体捐款、帮助安置救助美华。

一周后，杜小华接到曹县公安电话称，8月31日上午，孙美华被官方安置到本地养老院。

2022年“丰县铁链女事件”后，公安部曾宣布在全年开展打击拐卖妇女儿童犯罪专项行动，要求“集中摸排一批线索，特别是对来历不明的流浪乞讨、智力障碍、精神疾病、聋哑残疾等妇女儿童要全面摸排，确保底数清、情况明”。此后又在2024年部署新一轮打拐专项行动。公开统计资料显示，2022年至2024年，破获拐卖妇女案件总计1419起，获救被拐妇女总计1028人。

在这张全国摸排的“大网”中，卜花花和孙美华都是被遗漏的人。截至目前，山东曹县官方并未发布任何通报，无法确认孙美华与龙叔是否存在婚姻关系，也无法确认孙美华是通过怎样的程序上了户口。根据公开资料，2020年，即曹县公安声称孙美华上户口的同一年，民政部等多部门推动对流浪乞讨人员的落户安置。

与此同时，霞依然生活在龙叔的家里。霞曾向初心哭诉，“我怕我闺女跟我一样（被）卖到这儿来，那人贩子很厉害。我从陕西被卖到这儿来，我爹不知道我在哪，还以为我死了，就跑过来找一回、见过一面。”

过去的四年，初心一直在帮助她，如今的霞一头干净利落的短发，笑得更多，表达也更清晰，她的孩子也获得了更好的安置——翠翠被送至县城的特殊教育学校，国旗则前往一家爱心武校就读。现存最新的一条视频，是她带着霞和龙前往一家家具城，在好心老板的帮助下添置新家具。

而和她一起生活的龙，没有固定的劳动收入，在视频中寡言、支使霞做家务，生气时总是怒目圆睁。2025年2月，霞向初心倾诉，龙在前一天夜里殴打女儿翠翠，“（容易）把肺跺坏了”。她很心焦。面对初心的劝导和霞的气愤，龙侧着脸，背过镜头，手里握着一个烟盒，笑着点头应和。

在2024年，初心便帮助霞找到了位于陕西礼泉的娘家，但为何没能与家人彻底团圆不得而知，多只在逢年过节时回去看望，亦或是偶尔借初心的电话，跟父亲聊天。

## **美华的逃离因互联网而成为现实。**

9月8日，哥哥孙宝华前往山东，将孙美华接回了北京。

但团聚的曙光转瞬即逝。初次短暂的视频通话后，孙翠华发现，哥哥迅速改变了态度。他不仅在网络上指责热心寻人者公开发布视频是“伤害了家人”，迫使相关视频被下架，更以各种理由拉黑、拒绝了姐姐一家与妹妹的进一步通话请求。

孙美华没有被接回曾经的广内地区胡同老宅，而是被安置在丰台刘家窑一处两居室里。原先承诺的“接回家、重新上户口、大家轮流照顾”，迅速演变成了闭门隔绝。

姐夫刘安军曾尝试联系孙美华的前夫方某某，电话接通后，对方只冷漠地回应了一句“不认识”，便挂断了电话。美华女儿的电话则始终未能接通。据悉，女儿已经委托律师，帮助美华申请恢复原北京户籍，并要求其父亲签字承诺确保美华的安全，并放弃作为配偶对美华的第一位顺位监护权。

9月12日，身在北京的刘安军前往广内派出所等部门反映情况，试图厘清当年涉嫌遗弃及后续拐卖、收买的刑事责任，但得到的回复是“案子还在进行中”，对于非直系亲属保密。刘安军随后拨打了12345市民热线进行投诉控告。他不无怀疑，对于“孙美华事件”的封锁，像是主要针对他的“封杀”。他曾因拆迁纠纷被殴打，双侧股骨头坏死，后来发起“阳光公益”救济北京访民，成为被长期维稳的对象。

在近期委托律师团后，刘安军仍希望能与美华有一次“公开透明”的会见，期望中的监护权安排、刑事追责和寻求损害赔偿之路，每前进一点都步履维艰。9月14日，北京西城警方通知他，美华已进行包括妇科在内的多轮身体检查，整体伤情鉴定仍在处理中，但是否已立案侦查仍无明确说法。

隔着十二个小时的时差，孙翠华每天睡不了几个小时就会惊醒，精神深受刺激，近日已在家人安排下住院休养。她最恐惧的，是网络关注退去后，妹妹再次从公众视野里消失，甚至被悄无声息地送进封闭的精神病院度过余生。

“我特别感谢那些网友，没有好心人，这辈子我再也见不到妹妹了。”孙翠华在电话里声音沙哑。“我现在心里最疼的，就是她到底在外面受了多少罪？如果我父母还活着，看到他们的女儿变成今天这个样子，该有多心碎啊。”

距离美华回到北京已有两周多，刘安军只收到一张美华的近照：她被剔成寸头，脸色黝黑，眉头紧锁，眼睛眯成一条缝，仿佛还未从噩梦中醒来。而自9月24日起，他家房门外，已有警察24小时值守。

title: Florida pastor accused of role in Haitian president's assassination goes on trial
